  • Represent Kong most professionally and support our customers to the best of your ability.

  • Ability to travel to customer sites as required.

What You’ll Bring:

  • A true desire to see customers benefit from the investment they make with Kong.

  • 10 years or more of experience in selling enterprise software with a strong network in the enterprise domain.

  • Demonstrated success in selling to assigned named accounts, particularly to senior-level executives and across multiple departments.

  • Ability to leverage established relationships and proven sales techniques for success.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment, taking ownership of your sales territory and adapting to changing market dynamics.

  • Analytical and strategic thinking, with a knack for identifying business growth opportunities and devising plans to capitalise on them.

  • Effective communicator and strong interpersonal skills.

  • Excellent negotiation, presentation, and closing skills.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, EMEA Account Development (French speaker)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

There’s no AI without APIs. As we enter the agentic era, Kong sits at the heart of this transformation — making now an incredible time to join our journey.

About The Role:

 

ADR Leader, Enterprise Sales Development — EMEA

We are looking for an ADR Leader to build and lead our EMEA Account Development Representative team from our central London office (walking distance from Bank Station and London Bridge). This hybrid role offers the best of both worlds: the energy of in-person collaboration 2–3 days a week, combined with the flexibility of remote work.

 

As ADR Leader, you won't just manage a team - you'll be entrusted with something bigger. Our EMEA SDR leadership team are the market makers and drivers of growth at Kong. We don't just build pipeline; we define the blueprint for SDR excellence, shaping the next generation of top sales talent and driving winning outcomes for the business.

 

You'll show up with integrity, energy, and purpose and you'll build a team that does the same!

 

Kong is The AI Connectivity Company. Our platform sits at the centre of how enterprises manage APIs, AI agents, and the infrastructure connecting them — and we're scaling fast. The ADR function is the front line of that growth. Accounts you open today are the expansion stories of tomorrow, and the team you build here will be a meaningful part of how Kong writes its next chapter on the path to IPO.

 

What You'll Do:

  • Lead & Inspire: Build a culture that is high-performing and deeply human. SDRs on your team should be motivated, supported in their growth, and clear on what great looks like every day.

  • Hire & Plan for Talent: Own the talent pipeline end-to-end. Align with Recruiting on headcount and profiles, anticipate gaps before they land, and source proactively.

  • Ramp & Enable: Get new hires to productivity fast. Support the enablement team with running structured bootcamps, build individual development plans, and coach to certification. Every new hire should feel like they joined a team with a plan.

  • Coach for Excellence: Deliver regular call reviews, structured 1-1s, and AE-readiness programs. Coach to Attitude, Process, and Results — and know which leg of the stool is wobbling before the rep does.

  • Drive Pipeline: Own your team's contribution to EMEA pipeline targets with the forecasting discipline and visibility that Regional Directors can actually bet on.

  • GTM Ecosystem Alignment: Partner closely with Regional Directors, Marketing, RevOps, Partners, and Enablement. You're not managing in a silo, you're a connector as much as your reps are.

  • Data-Driven Leadership: Track KPIs, analyse team performance, and drive process improvements that maximise efficiency and results.

  • Champion Tools & Process: Drive effective use of Salesforce, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and other prospecting tools across the team.

 

What You'll Bring:

  • 5 years of management experience leading SDR, ADR, or BDR teams in a tech or SaaS environment.

  • Proven success building and scaling high-performance outbound teams, particularly in an enterprise context.

  • Strong background in coaching, enablement, and AE readiness. You think about career paths the same way you think about quota attainment, proactively.

  • A clear point of view on what good enterprise outbound looks like, and the competence to build it.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

About the Role:

We are seeking a committed Enterprise Sales Executive with a successful background in sales and account management, ideally within open source or similar enterprise software environments. In this role, you will be a key driver of our growth strategy, directly impacting the stability and expansion of our recurring revenue. This position is ideal for a sales professional who has experience in landing new clients, retaining existing customers, and driving account expansion for early-stage enterprise products in a dynamic, entrepreneurial setting.

At Kong, we offer UNCAPPED COMMISSIONS with MASSIVE UPSIDE, competitive benefits, and equity in a company with huge growth potential.

 

What You’ll Do:

  • Develop and execute sales strategies to target enterprise customers, focusing on building and maintaining a robust pipeline that drives long-term growth.

  • Own the entire sales cycle, from prospecting and initial outreach to contract negotiations and closing deals, while consistently meeting or exceeding revenue targets.

  • Collaborate with internal teams, including product, marketing, and customer success, to ensure a seamless sales experience and alignment on customer needs.

  • Identify customer pain points and align our solutions to address these, delivering customized product demos and presentations tailored to their specific business needs.

  • Build and nurture relationships with C-level executives and key decision-makers within target accounts, establishing yourself as a trusted advisor and ensuring customer satisfaction and retention.

  • Lead account planning efforts by researching potential customers, understanding industry trends, and developing strategies to win new business and grow existing accounts.

  • Monitor and manage sales activities and results, accurately forecasting opportunities and keeping detailed records of interactions and progress in CRM systems.

  • Stay updated on industry trends, competitor offerings, and market changes to position our product effectively and maintain a competitive edge.

  • Contribute to business growth initiatives, providing feedback to product and marketing teams to influence product development and go-to-market strategies.

  • Represent Kong with professionalism, acting as a brand ambassador at industry events, conferences, and customer meetings.

 

What You’ll Bring:

  • 7+ years of experience in enterprise sales (>5k employees), with a proven track record of closing complex deals in a SaaS, cloud, or enterprise software environment.

  • Demonstrated success in selling to large enterprises, particularly to senior-level executives and across multiple departments.

  • Strong consultative selling skills, with the ability to understand customer needs and present compelling solutions that drive business outcomes.

  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills, capable of managing high-stakes conversations and building lasting relationships with stakeholders.

  • A results-driven mindset, with a passion for meeting and exceeding sales goals and revenue targets.

  • Experience working with CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce) and leveraging data to forecast accurately and track sales metrics.

  • Knowledge of open-source software, APIs, or infrastructure software is highly advantageous.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment, taking ownership of your sales territory and adapting to changing market dynamics.

  • Analytical and strategic thinking, with a knack for identifying business growth opportunities and devising plans to capitalize on them.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager - Test Function
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About the Role:

As the Senior Engineering Manager, you will serve as the global leader for Quality Engineering across Kong’s flagship runtime platforms (AI Gateway, API Gateway, Event Gateway and Mesh).

This is a high-visibility, transformative leadership role. Beyond overseeing our distributed global SDET organization, you will be the primary architect of Kong’s next-generation AI-driven testing strategy. You will spearhead the transformation of our quality engineering function from traditional automation to an intelligent, agentic, self-healing test substrate, using LLMs and automated prompt/agent loops to test the very infrastructure powering the AI era.

What You’ll Do:

  • Global Team Leadership & Operations: Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing, geographically distributed team of Software Development Engineers in Test (SDETs) across North America, Europe, and Asia.

  • Architect the AI Testing Strategy: Define and execute the roadmap for integrating AI, LLMs, and autonomous test agents directly into our testing lifecycle. Implement generative AI capabilities for automated test case generation, smart failure triage, self-healing test scripts, and dynamic edge-case synthesis.

  • Own Runtimes Quality Strategy: Establish testing strategies for low-latency, high-throughput C/Lua/Rust data planes.

  • Modernize Frameworks & CI/CD Pipelines: Oversee the architectural evolution of our end-to-end, performance, regression, and chaos-testing automation harnesses embedded within modern CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Docker, K8s).

  • Shift-Left Quality & Governance: Drive quality ownership upstream. Partner closely with Software Engineering and Product Management to embed rigorous testability standards into initial architectural designs.

  • Define Enterprise-Grade Metrics: Establish and monitor clear QE health indicators (e.g., CI signal reliability, automation coverage, defect density, time-to-triage, and release stability).

What You’ll Bring:

  • 10+ Years in Software Engineering / SDET: Proven track record building and scaling enterprise software test automation systems.

  • 4+ Years in Engineering Management: Direct experience leading distributed or global software engineering/SDET teams.

  • Hands-on AI Integration Vision: Proven experience applying LLMs, Generative AI, or autonomous agent frameworks (e.g., Model Context Protocol, agentic tool-calling, synthetic data generation) to software quality or developer workflows.

  • Operational Excellence: Demonstrated ability to manage follow-the-sun operational cadence, vendor partnerships, and cross-timezone execution seamlessly.

Bonus Points:

  • Direct experience testing high-performance networking data planes, proxies, or API Gateways (e.g., Kong, NGINX, Envoy).

  • Background in performance, chaos engineering (e.g., Gremlin, Litmus), and load testing high-availability SaaS platforms.

  • Active involvement or contributions to open-source quality frameworks or AI development tooling.

postalAddress.streetAddress: 13th Floor, Panchshil Avenue, Survey No. 210, Plot No. 71, Kalyani Nagar – Wadgaon Sheri Road, Next to Marigold Complex, Yerwada, Pune

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

The Mission:

As Kong accelerates toward an IPO and the next stage of enterprise growth, finance systems must evolve from operational tools into strategic business enablers. We are seeking a visionary Finance Systems leader to define the strategy, architecture, and execution of our financial technology ecosystem. In this role, you will build a scalable, resilient, and AI-powered finance platform that delivers trusted data, streamlined operations, and the controls required to support a world-class public company.

What You'll Do:

  • Own the strategy, administration, and long-term roadmap for our core finance systems, including NetSuite, Celigo, Brex, Pigment, and Zip, ensuring reliability, scalability, and operational excellence.

  • Design, build, and govern mission-critical integrations across the enterprise ecosystem—including Salesforce, Workday, Ashby, and other business applications—to ensure accurate, timely, and seamless data flow.

  • Establish best-in-class governance, controls, and monitoring to maintain data integrity, strengthen audit readiness, and ensure SOX-compliant financial processes.

  • Champion AI-driven transformation within Finance by designing intelligent automations that eliminate manual work, improve reporting accuracy, and accelerate business decision-making.

  • Partner closely with Accounting, FP&A, Revenue Operations, HR, and IT to translate evolving business requirements into scalable systems and process solutions.

  • Lead enterprise-wide finance systems initiatives—including implementations, upgrades, migrations, and vendor evaluations—from strategy through successful deployment and adoption.

  • Drive operational excellence by managing a robust support model with defined SLAs, proactive issue resolution, and strong strategic partnerships with key technology vendors.

  • Continuously optimize the finance technology landscape by identifying opportunities to simplify processes, improve user experience, and enable business growth.

What You'll Bring:

Experience

  • 12+ years of progressive experience leading Finance Systems in high-growth SaaS organizations, with demonstrated ownership of enterprise financial platforms.

  • Proven success scaling finance systems through rapid growth, ideally supporting organizations from $100M to $750M+ ARR, including both pre-IPO and public company environments.

  • Deep hands-on expertise administering NetSuite and modern integration platforms such as Celigo, Workato, or Boomi.

  • Strong experience implementing and integrating finance applications across ERP, FP&A, spend management, procurement, CRM, and HRIS platforms, including tools such as Brex, Pigment (or Anaplan), Zip, Salesforce, and Workday.

  • Demonstrated success designing and delivering AI-powered automation solutions that drive measurable improvements in finance operations, rather than simply adopting AI tools.

  • Strong SQL and analytical skills, with the ability to independently investigate data issues, validate system outputs, and ensure financial data accuracy.

  • A strategic mindset combined with hands-on technical expertise, capable of balancing long-term architecture with day-to-day operational excellence.

  • Excellent cross-functional communication and stakeholder management skills, with a proven ability to influence executives and collaborate across Finance, IT, and business teams.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

About the Role:

The Administrative Assistant provides high-quality administrative and operational support to the EMEA & APJ Sales VPship team. The role is responsible for keeping senior leaders organized, on schedule, and focused on their highest priorities.

This is an execution-focused role centered on calendar management, travel coordination, expense administration, and day-to-day logistics. The position reports to the Executive Assistant to the CRO and is not responsible for business strategy, content ownership, or analysis.

What You'll Do:

Calendar & Schedule Management

  • Own and manage complex, multi-time-zone calendars for EMEA & APJ Sales VPs.

  • Anticipate and proactively resolve scheduling conflicts with minimal disruption.

  • Prioritize meeting requests based on leadership priorities, business rhythms, and urgency.

  • Coordinate effectively with internal and external stakeholders to schedule meetings efficiently.

  • Ensure leaders are well prepared and their schedules remain organized and optimized.

Travel Coordination

  • Coordinate end-to-end domestic and international travel, including flights, hotels, ground transportation, and visas.

  • Develop clear, detailed travel itineraries and travel briefs to minimize friction for leaders.

  • Monitor travel plans and proactively manage changes, delays, and disruptions.

  • Ensure all travel arrangements comply with company policies and processes.

Expense Management

  • Prepare, submit, and track expense reports on behalf of supported leaders.

  • Ensure expenses are submitted accurately, promptly, and in accordance with company policies.

  • Manage expense-related follow-ups, questions, and reconciliations as needed.

General Administrative Support

  • Serve as the primary administrative point of contact and liaison for the EMEA & APJ Sales VPs.

  • Manage incoming and outgoing communications, document distribution, and administrative inquiries with professionalism and discretion.

  • Maintain well-organized digital files and ensure accurate record-keeping of key documents and administrative assets.

  • Identify opportunities to improve administrative processes and proactively recommend practical solutions.

  • Handle sensitive and confidential information with a high degree of discretion and sound judgment.

Scope of the Role:

The role is designed to enable senior leaders to focus on business priorities by taking ownership of operational and administrative responsibilities.

The following areas are out of scope for this position:

  • QBR and Town Hall content, strategy, narratives, or metrics ownership.

  • Business analysis, sales reporting, or data interpretation.

  • People management or HR responsibilities.

  • Budget ownership or financial decision-making.

What You'll Bring:

Required

  • 3+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Administrative Assistant, or in a similar role supporting senior business leaders.

  • Demonstrated experience managing complex, multi-time-zone calendars with a high degree of accuracy and prioritization.

  • Experience coordinating domestic and international travel and preparing detailed travel itineraries.

  • Proficiency with expense management tools and processes.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with professional fluency.

  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities without losing attention to detail.

  • High level of discretion and sound judgment when handling sensitive or confidential information.

  • Proficiency with productivity and collaboration tools such as Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack, Zoom, and Concur or similar expense platforms.

Preferred:

  • Experience supporting senior leaders within a global or matrixed organization.

  • Experience working with stakeholders across multiple regions and time zones.

  • Familiarity with EMEA business practices and European and Asia-Pacific working environments.

  • Proficiency in one or more additional European or Asia-Pacific languages.

About the Team:

This role is part of a growing Executive and Administrative Assistant function designed to provide scalable, high-quality support to the company's Vice Presidents.

As the first EMEA & APJ-focused Administrative Assistant, you will have an opportunity to help establish best practices, shape administrative processes, and define what exceptional administrative support looks like as the team grows.

This is an opportunity for a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented professional to make a meaningful impact by enabling senior leaders to operate efficiently across regions and time zones.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About the Role:
Kong is building the future of API management for developers. We’re a fast-growing, well-funded company with happy customers and motivated employees. Insomnia, acquired in 2019, is a full-lifecycle API development platform that has quickly become an integral part of Kong’s product portfolio.
As a Staff Software Engineer on the Konnect team at Kong, you’ll architect Kong Identity's multi-tenant identity platform supporting complex organizational hierarchies, cross-tenant isolation, and enterprise-grade security controls.

 

What You'll Do:

  • Design and implement advanced token management systems, including refresh token rotation, proof-of-possession tokens, and custom token introspection with real-time revocation capabilities.

  • Lead development of Kong Identity's extensible claims engine supporting dynamic attribute resolution, contextual claim injection, and complex business logic evaluation at token issuance.

  • Architect global identity infrastructure with edge optimization, intelligent token caching, and cross-region replication strategies for sub-millisecond authentication latency worldwide.

  • Design sophisticated rate limiting, anomaly detection, and fraud prevention systems to protect against credential stuffing, token abuse, and distributed attacks.

  • Build enterprise identity federation capabilities, including SAML bridge patterns, external IdP chaining, and custom protocol adapters for legacy system integration.

  • Lead technical strategy for Kong Identity's developer experience, including SDKs, webhooks, audit logging, and real-time analytics dashboards for token lifecycle visibility.

  • Architect advanced client management systems supporting dynamic client registration, automated credential rotation, and programmatic policy enforcement.

  • Design Kong Identity's plugin architecture enables custom grant flows, protocol extensions, and third-party integrations while maintaining security boundaries.

  • Drive implementation of compliance frameworks (SOC 2, FedRAMP, GDPR), including comprehensive audit trails, data residency controls, and privacy-preserving token designs.

  • Lead technical initiatives for Kong Identity's integration with observability platforms, supporting distributed tracing, metrics collection, and security event correlation.

  • Mentor engineering teams on advanced identity concepts including zero-trust architectures, workload identity, and service mesh integration patterns.

     

What You'll Bring:

  • 7+ years of experience building production identity platforms at leading identity providers or enterprise software companies, with proven track record of handling millions of authentication requests daily.

  • Deep expertise in advanced OAuth 2.0 extensions (PKCE, mTLS, JWT bearer assertions, token exchange), OpenID Connect profiles, and emerging standards like OAuth 2.1 and GNAP.

  • Proven experience architecting multi-tenant identity platforms with complex isolation requirements, tenant-specific configurations, and enterprise feature sets.

  • Strong background in cryptographic protocols including advanced JWT patterns, key rotation strategies, Hardware Security Module (HSM) integration, and post-quantum cryptography considerations.

  • Experience building identity platforms with sophisticated analytics, real-time monitoring, and security event detection capabilities at enterprise scale.

  • Expertise in global identity infrastructure including edge deployment strategies, geo-distributed token validation, and cross-region data consistency patterns.

  • Deep understanding of enterprise identity integration patterns including SAML federation, LDAP/AD bridges, SCIM provisioning, and custom protocol adapters.

  • Proven track record building developer-first identity platforms including comprehensive SDKs, webhook systems, and extensible API designs.

  • Experience with identity platform security including threat modeling, penetration testing coordination, and implementation of advanced attack prevention mechanisms.

  • Strong background in compliance and regulatory requirements for identity systems including audit trail design, data residency controls, and privacy engineering.

  • Experience building identity platforms supporting complex organizational structures, delegated administration, and fine-grained permission models.

  • Expertise in high-performance system design including horizontal scaling strategies, caching architectures, and latency optimization for identity operations.

  • Knowledge of service mesh identity patterns, workload identity bootstrapping, and integration with container orchestration platforms.

  • Experience with identity protocol extensions, custom grant flows, and building extensible identity platforms that support diverse use cases.

  • Proven ability to lead technical initiatives in complex, regulated environments while balancing innovation with security and compliance requirements.

About the Role:
Kong is building the future of API management for developers. We’re a fast-growing, well-funded company with happy customers and motivated employees. Insomnia, acquired in 2019, is a full-lifecycle API development platform that has quickly become an integral part of Kong’s product portfolio.
As a Staff Software Engineer on the Konnect team at Kong, you’ll architect Kong Identity's multi-tenant identity platform supporting complex organizational hierarchies, cross-tenant isolation, and enterprise-grade security controls.

 

What You'll Do:

 - Design and implement advanced token management systems, including refresh token rotation, proof-of-possession tokens, and custom token introspection with real-time revocation capabilities.

 - Lead development of Kong Identity's extensible claims engine supporting dynamic attribute resolution, contextual claim injection, and complex business logic evaluation at token issuance.

 - Architect global identity infrastructure with edge optimization, intelligent token caching, and cross-region replication strategies for sub-millisecond authentication latency worldwide.

 - Design sophisticated rate limiting, anomaly detection, and fraud prevention systems to protect against credential stuffing, token abuse, and distributed attacks.

 - Build enterprise identity federation capabilities, including SAML bridge patterns, external IdP chaining, and custom protocol adapters for legacy system integration.

 - Lead technical strategy for Kong Identity's developer experience, including SDKs, webhooks, audit logging, and real-time analytics dashboards for token lifecycle visibility.

 - Architect advanced client management systems supporting dynamic client registration, automated credential rotation, and programmatic policy enforcement.

 - Design Kong Identity's plugin architecture enables custom grant flows, protocol extensions, and third-party integrations while maintaining security boundaries.

 - Drive implementation of compliance frameworks (SOC 2, FedRAMP, GDPR), including comprehensive audit trails, data residency controls, and privacy-preserving token designs.

 - Lead technical initiatives for Kong Identity's integration with observability platforms, supporting distributed tracing, metrics collection, and security event correlation.

 - Mentor engineering teams on advanced identity concepts including zero-trust architectures, workload identity, and service mesh integration patterns.
   
    

What You'll Bring:

 - 7+ years of experience building production identity platforms at leading identity providers or enterprise software companies, with proven track record of handling millions of authentication requests daily.

 - Deep expertise in advanced OAuth 2.0 extensions (PKCE, mTLS, JWT bearer assertions, token exchange), OpenID Connect profiles, and emerging standards like OAuth 2.1 and GNAP.

 - Proven experience architecting multi-tenant identity platforms with complex isolation requirements, tenant-specific configurations, and enterprise feature sets.

 - Strong background in cryptographic protocols including advanced JWT patterns, key rotation strategies, Hardware Security Module (HSM) integration, and post-quantum cryptography considerations.

 - Experience building identity platforms with sophisticated analytics, real-time monitoring, and security event detection capabilities at enterprise scale.

 - Expertise in global identity infrastructure including edge deployment strategies, geo-distributed token validation, and cross-region data consistency patterns.

 - Deep understanding of enterprise identity integration patterns including SAML federation, LDAP/AD bridges, SCIM provisioning, and custom protocol adapters.

 - Proven track record building developer-first identity platforms including comprehensive SDKs, webhook systems, and extensible API designs.

 - Experience with identity platform security including threat modeling, penetration testing coordination, and implementation of advanced attack prevention mechanisms.

 - Strong background in compliance and regulatory requirements for identity systems including audit trail design, data residency controls, and privacy engineering.

 - Experience building identity platforms supporting complex organizational structures, delegated administration, and fine-grained permission models.

 - Expertise in high-performance system design including horizontal scaling strategies, caching architectures, and latency optimization for identity operations.

 - Knowledge of service mesh identity patterns, workload identity bootstrapping, and integration with container orchestration platforms.

 - Experience with identity protocol extensions, custom grant flows, and building extensible identity platforms that support diverse use cases.

 - Proven ability to lead technical initiatives in complex, regulated environments while balancing innovation with security and compliance requirements.

jobs.descriptionHtml:

The is a hybrid role is based in Sydney.

About the Role:

At Kong, our Sales Development team works closely with our partners in both Sales and Marketing to build fanatical customer enthusiasm around Kong. Sales Development reps are responsible for identifying and qualifying new opportunities for our sales organization. We view our Sales Development program as the best way to turbocharge a long and successful career in sales and view our Sales Development Representatives (SDRs) as the next wave of Account Executives at Kong.

To aid in this endeavor, we invest heavily in the training and development of our team. This includes a 2-week long sales bootcamp, weekly 1-1 mentorship, and global virtual group trainings. By joining our team, you are making an investment in yourself that will accelerate the rest of your sales career.

Our SDRs gain an understanding of our product, community, who we sell to, why they care, and what makes us relevant. They learn how to generate a pipeline quickly and effectively as well as how to achieve a good discovery and qualification. The team is a crucial resource for sales teams across Kong to get great talent from. This helps us scale our teams, as well as ensure that we have a culture of meritocracy.

Being an SDR, is often a first step to jump-starting a career in sales. At Kong, we have a culture that celebrates diversity, fosters growth and enablement, and ensures that we provide our SDRs with the tools and the confidence that they need to grow their careers.

The SDR leadership team has a true understanding of where each SDR is at in their personal development process, and mentors and enables them to ensure that they have the means and opportunity to be considered for their next role. At Kong, we truly believe that if you want to earn your MBA in sales, this is the place to be. As a leadership team, we spend an exorbitant amount of time working in the trenches with our teams to help them fine hone their business and sales acumen and ramp them to productivity, success, and greater roles.

 

What You'll Do:

Market Opportunity - We are on a quest to build a $10b+ software company over the next few years and need YOUR help!

Why APIs Matter? APIs have been enabling innovation for decades!

Strong VC team, Series D, strong year over year revenue growth!

Technical Leadership - We are recognized as the leader in innovation in the connectivity space.

Marco, our CTO/co-founder - “We are the Cisco of L4 and L7” - CUBE Conversation, March 2021

We are the leading innovator in the connectivity space!

Amazing Team & Culture - Come be a "Konger" and find out what we mean.

Great Place to Work Certified in 2020 & 2021

Kong employees exemplify our culture at our 2022 Sales Kickoff

2022 Forbes Cloud 100 Honoree

Building Great Products - Learn why the world's largest companies love our tech!

Kong Named a Leader in the 2023 Gartner Magic Quadrant

Over 250m+ downloads of our open source API gateway! Over 40k+ stars on Github between Kong API and Kong Insomnia!

What you'll be doing: Your First 90 Days

  • By the end of month 1, you will:

  • Have met your new team and had fun playing with some new tools

  • Become a part of the wider Kong family

  • Have had a successful sales boot camp training

  • Have a good understanding of what makes Kong’s product offerings so special

  • Understand how our Sales Development, Marketing and Account Executive teams all work together

  • By the end of month 2, you will:

  • Be comfortable talking to clients on the phone about Kong

  • Have worked with our Account Executive team on your first opportunity

  • Have shadowed a ton of calls and practiced several role-plays

  • Started delivering your ramp quota

  • By the end of month 3, you will:

  • Know our sales funnel inside and out, and feel confident to add value to our sales org

  • Show clear delivery of our sales methodologies

  • Provide insights to both our Sales Development and marketing organizations to help us continue to iterate and improve

  • Delivered against your ramp quota

  • Role Overview & Key Responsibilities:

  • Work with the Sales team to develop inbound and outbound campaigns from idea generation through to qualified call

  • Develop strong sales and product knowledge.

  • Interact with IT and business decision-makers via telephone, video, LinkedIn, and email

  • Update lead and prospect activity in Salesforce to ensure effective lead management

  • Set qualified introductory meetings for the Sales team

  • Nurture early phase opportunities for future pipeline potential

  • Exceed monthly and quarterly opportunity quota

  • Build strong relationships with our marketing team and Account Executives, where we pull together to maximize the win for our business.

  • Invest in your self-development, focusing on the skills and attributes that will make you successful in your core role and get you set for future success

  • And any additional tasks required by the manager.

     

What You'll Bring:

  • 1 year or more of strong sales or customer-facing experience.

  • A self-starter with a track record of hitting and exceeding goals.

  • A ‘hunter’ mentality - comfortable prospecting, cold-calling, and following up on incoming leads and a strong desire to win.

  • Ability and willingness to learn, react to and share lessons learned across the organisation.

  • Open to feedback and can apply to your daily workflow.

  • Outstanding communication skills including both phone and written communication as well as active listening.

  • An extraordinary character with an incredible drive for success, a high work ethic, curious by nature, and obsessed with smashing sales goals.

  • Validated time leadership skills and ability to work independently and through coaching.

  • Desire to work in a driven and fast-paced environment.

  • Passionate about cutting-edge technology with the aptitude to learn new and exciting IT software products, as well as, understand business critical solutions quickly.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, AI Management
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About the Role:

Kong is building the future of AI connectivity, empowering developers to connect, secure, govern, and scale their AI applications with speed and intelligence. Kong's AI Management solution – including our flagship AI Gateway – is one of our most strategic and fastest-growing product areas, and we're growing the team to match.

We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to join the AI Management product team, based in our Milan office. You'll be the product owner for some of our most exciting, fastest-growing agentic AI management and infrastructure products.

You'll work in close partnership with the broader AI Management research & development team, with a focus on driving definition and delivery of features and cross-team product work, collaborating with product managers and engineers around the world, while also supporting the field activities, including product marketing, sales, and enablement. This is a high-impact, hands-on product management role that reports directly to our Director & Head of AI Products.

 
 

What You’ll Do:

  • AI Management Product Modules: Own the product direction for AI Management product modules that help connect, govern, supervise, and optimize agentic AI, including models, context, agentic harnesses, guardrails, evaluation, policies, and more. You'll define requirements, write specs, prioritize the backlog, and drive delivery of your module’s features in close collaboration with engineering.

  • Cross-Product Infrastructure & Dependencies: Drive the cross-product work that connects your AI Management modules to other modules within AI Management, as well as Kong’s broader platform. You'll navigate shared roadmaps, negotiate priorities across teams, and ensure AI Gateway's infrastructure needs aren't blocked by cross-team complexity.

  • Roadmap & Delivery: Own a clearly defined product roadmap for your areas, balancing new feature development against technical debt, infrastructure work, and platform dependencies. You'll partner with engineering leads to scope work, make trade-off decisions, and maintain a reliable delivery cadence.

  • Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the connective tissue between engineering, design, product marketing, and leadership for your areas of ownership. Keep stakeholders informed, surface risks early, and ensure alignment across time zones and teams.

  • Field Support: Support regional field activities as needed — such as customer-facing calls, product marketing input, or sales enablement — particularly where your proximity in Shanghai and knowledge of the runtime add value.

 

You’ll Thrive in This Role If You:

  • Have 7-10 years of product management experience, with a track record of owning and shipping technical products — ideally in agentic AI, infrastructure, developer tools, and/or platform software.

  • Have experience driving product delivery across distributed teams — you're comfortable working across time zones, navigating dependencies between teams, and keeping things moving without having direct authority over every contributor.

  • Are strong at translating ambiguous technical problems into clear product requirements — you can take a messy infrastructure challenge, break it down, and turn it into a spec that engineering can execute against.

  • Communicate clearly and proactively — you'll be the bridge between globally distributed stakeholders, across multiple functions and levels of seniority, so strong written and verbal communication in both languages is essential.

  • Have solid project management instincts — you may not be a full-time project manager, but you know how to track work, surface blockers, and keep a roadmap on track without being asked.

  • Are comfortable engaging with technical depth — you don't need to write code, but you should be able to hold your own in conversations about MCP servers, transport protocols, request routing, data plane architecture, and infrastructure trade-offs.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About the Role:

Kong's Milan office is growing fast — from a handful of people to dozens across engineering, R&D, and operations — and this role is what keeps it running day to day.

  • You'll be the hands-on IT presence on the ground: setting up a new hire's laptop before their first day, keeping Wi-Fi and access working without drama, and being the first call when something breaks

  • You'll report to the IT Director, who leads IT Operations globally, and join a small, distributed team that's covering EMEA, India and Americas

  • You will be the only one physically in Milan, which means real ownership over how the office runs

  • This role sits at the intersection of IT support, systems administration, and light security operations — comfortable with a help-desk ticket one hour and a firewall or DNS issue the next

 

What You’ll Do:

 

  • Own day-to-day IT support for the Milan office: device lifecycle (order, ship, enroll, retire),

  • Zoom room/AV setup, and hands-on troubleshooting across Mac, Windows and mobile.

  • Administer core tools — Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom — handling onboarding/offboarding, access, licensing and security settings.

  • Manage endpoints via MDM (Intune or similar) and keep an eye on endpoint security (CrowdStrike or equivalent EDR).

  • Get hands-on with network and infrastructure basics — firewall, Wi-Fi, DNS — so we're not dependent on outside vendors when something goes down.

  • Work tickets in our ITSM tool (Freshservice/ServiceNow-style), prioritizing by real business impact and keeping SLAs tight.

 

What You’ll Bring:

 

  • 3+ years in IT support/operations;

  • Hands-on Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom; solid MDM experience (Iru is great — Intune/Jamf also fine);

  • Genuine network/systems admin exposure (Wi-Fi, firewall, DNS);

  • ITSM ticketing experience;

  • Fluent professional English.

Nice-to-have: Okta/Jamf-style certifications; experience automating recurring ticket workflows to cut down manual work.

jobs.title: GTM Sourcing Recruiter (Contract)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

The Mission
Kong is scaling rapidly. We are building a world-class revenue engine, and to do that, we need a GTM Sourcing Recruiter who doesn't just fill seats but identifies elite talent. Our sales organization operates on MEDDIC. We believe that rigorous qualification applies just as much to hiring as it does to selling. We are looking for a talent partner who can audit a candidate’s GTM acumen, dig into their operational and executional mechanics, and ensure they have the DNA to drive big wins and make a big impact.

The Role
As a GTM Recruiter, you will help own the hiring strategy for some of our most critical roles in the CRO org. You will act as a strategic advisor to our GTM Leaders and you won’t just be passing over resumes; you will be conducting deep-dive competency interviews to ensure every candidate we hire raises the bar.


What You Will Do

1. Strategic Sourcing & Headhunting

  • Build and nurture a pipeline of top talent

  • Map out competitor sales orgs and execute targeted headhunting campaigns.

  • Sell the Kong vision, equity story, and product value to passive candidates who aren't actively looking.

2. Stakeholder Partnership

  • Partner with GTM Leadership to define "What Good Looks Like" for each specific role, region, and function.

  • Provide real-time market data to hiring managers regarding salary bands, talent density, and competitor compensation.

  • Challenge hiring managers when necessary - you are the expert on talent.

3. Thorough Candidate Assessment

  • Go beyond the resume: Assess candidates on their specific deal mechanics. (e.g., "Who was the Economic Buyer in your biggest win?" "What Metrics did you use to build the business case?")

  • Filter out drivers from passengers, lucky sellers from strategic sellers, etc. by digging into their process, business, and achievements.

4. Operational Excellence

  • Drive a rigorous interview process that balances speed with quality.

  • Help Educate and Mentor other recruiters on GTM terminology, objection handling, and closing strategies.

  • Track conversion metrics to optimize the funnel (e.g., Passthrough Rates)

What you will bring

  • Experience: GTM Sourcing experience, with a heavy focus on B2B SaaS / Enterprise Software Sales.

  • Methodology Native: You are fluent in MEDDIC / MEDDPICC. You know the difference between a Champion and a Coach, and you know how to test a candidate's grasp of these concepts.

  • Scale-Up Resilient: You thrive in ambiguity. You can build a plane while flying it and adapt quickly when priorities change.

  • Hunter Mentality: You don’t rely on inbound applicants. You enjoy the hunt and have a creative toolkit for finding hidden talent.

  • Data-Driven: You use data to influence decisions and track your own performance.

#LI-MC1

The Senior Sales Enablement Manager, APJ will play a critical role in equipping the sales team with the tools, training, content, and processes they need to drive revenue and meet business goals. This role focuses on aligning the sales and marketing efforts, improving efficiency, and optimizing the buyer’s journey in a fast-paced SaaS environment.

  • Develop and manage a comprehensive onboarding program for new sales hires.

  • Provide ongoing training to ensure the sales team stays updated on product offerings, industry trends, and best practices.

 

Content Development and Management:

  1. Create, curate, and organize sales enablement content, including playbooks, case studies, presentations, and competitive battle cards.

  2. Collaborate with marketing to ensure the content aligns with the sales strategy and resonates with the target audience.

 

Tool and Technology Management:

  1. Implement and manage sales enablement tools such as CRM, analytics platforms, and learning management systems (e.g., Salesforce, Gong, Seismic or Highspot).

  2. Ensure seamless integration of tools into sales workflows to increase productivity.

Performance Analysis:

  1. Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of enablement initiatives through KPIs such as sales\productivity, win rates, and quota attainment.

Cross-functional Collaboration:

  1. Partner with product, marketing, and customer success teams to align sales strategies with product launches and customer needs.

  2. Act as a bridge between sales and other departments to ensure a consistent message throughout the buyer’s journey.

 

Sales Process Optimization:

  1. Standardize sales processes and methodologies to enhance efficiency and scalability.

  2. Identify gaps and bottlenecks in the sales process and implement solutions to address them.

  • Experience: 5+ years in sales enablement, training, or related roles, preferably in the SaaS industry.

  • and content management systems.

  • Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication abilities to create impactful content and

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

Senior Technical Product Marketing Manager, Agent Identity & Auth (EMEA)

Location: EMEA

About the Role:

As enterprises move from AI experiments to production agentic systems, a new problem has emerged: agents are non-human actors that need identity, authentication, and authorization — and the traditional identity stack wasn't built for them.

This role owns Kong's story in one of the most important emerging categories in AI infrastructure. As Senior Technical PMM for Agent Identity & Auth, you'll define how the market understands agent identity: how agents are authenticated, what they're authorized to access, and how enterprises establish trust and accountability across autonomous systems.

This is a category-shaping role. You'll build the narrative for a market that's still being defined, with the opportunity to establish Kong as the definitive voice on non-human identity in agentic architectures.

What You'll Do:

  • Own positioning and messaging for agent identity and auth — Define the technical narrative for how Kong authenticates, authorizes, and governs agents and other non-human actors across AI and API traffic.

  • Shape the category — Develop thought leadership that frames the agent identity problem for the market and establishes Kong's point of view through blogs, talks, analyst conversations, and industry engagement.

  • Lead technical field enablement — Own enablement in this domain for Kong Solution Engineers, Customer Success Managers, and other technical field roles.

  • Produce deep technical content — Build demos, reference architectures, technical whitepapers, and documentation-adjacent content that helps architects and security teams evaluate and adopt Kong's approach.

  • Support strategic deals — Serve as the subject-matter expert for sales conversations where agent identity and security are strategic decision criteria, particularly with security and platform engineering buyers.

  • Fuel launches and campaigns — Deliver technical positioning, proof points, and demo assets as structured inputs to the AI PMM's launch and campaign motions.

  • Partner with product management — Inform roadmap framing and capability naming based on market feedback, competitive dynamics, and buyer research.

What You'll Bring:

  • 5+ years of experience in product marketing, product management, or solutions engineering -ideally at an Identity and Access Management (IAM) and/or AI Security company.

  • A genuine, hands-on interest in AI infrastructure. You follow developments in LLM deployment, agentic frameworks, the Model Context Protocol, and AI governance, and can speak credibly to AI platform engineers without bluffing.

  • A proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into crisp narratives that land with both technical practitioners and C-suite buyers.

  • Highly collaborative -you thrive working across Product, Marketing, Sales, and Partner teams.

  • Comfortable owning a stage: keynote presentations, analyst briefings, customer roundtables, and demo-heavy sessions energize you rather than intimidate you.

  • Experience in open-source software, SaaS platforms, and enterprise go-to-market motions is strongly preferred.

  • Familiarity with the AI connectivity landscape -including awareness of competing and complementary vendors across API gateways, AI observability, vector databases, iPaaS, and agentic orchestration frameworks - is a strong plus.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

About the Role:

Join the global leader in API and AI governance in the era of Artificial Intelligence!

 

API traffic now outnumbers human traffic online, and a significant portion of that traffic is powered by the Kong platform, the world’s most popular API gateway. As organizations modernize for AI-driven connectivity, Kong is uniquely positioned at the center of enterprise transformation.

We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to join Kong’s growing Professional Services organization. This is a highly strategic, customer-facing engineering role focused on helping enterprise customers accelerate adoption of Kong’s API and AI Connectivity platform through hands-on implementation, automation, migration tooling, and solution engineering.

 

As an FDE, you will work directly alongside customer engineering teams to solve complex technical challenges, accelerate migrations, build reusable automation, and deliver production-grade solutions in real-world enterprise environments. You will operate at the intersection of software engineering, architecture, platform engineering, and customer delivery.

This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy building, coding, solving ambiguous problems, and working directly with customers on mission-critical initiatives involving APIs, AI gateways, service connectivity, modernization, and cloud-native platforms.

You will collaborate closely with Solutions Architects, Engagement Managers, Product Engineering, Customer Success, and Product teams to ensure successful customer outcomes while also influencing Kong’s product direction based on field experience.

Working at Kong is a unique opportunity to make a massive impact on Fortune 50/500 customers as they modernize mission-critical systems for the AI era.

 

Impact

Work directly with some of the world’s largest enterprises to modernize API infrastructure and accelerate AI adoption through Kong’s connectivity platform.

Growth

Accelerate your technical and professional growth through exposure to cutting-edge cloud-native technologies, distributed systems, AI connectivity, automation frameworks, and large-scale enterprise architectures.

Opportunity

Be part of a rapidly growing Professional Services organization that is shaping how enterprises adopt APIs, AI gateways, and modern connectivity platforms globally.

 
 

What You’ll Do:

  • Partner directly with enterprise customers to design, build, and implement Kong-based solutions across cloud, hybrid, and on-premise environments.

  • Lead hands-on implementation efforts for API gateways, AI gateways, service mesh, developer portals, and related connectivity technologies.

  • Build automation frameworks, migration tooling, custom integrations, and reusable accelerators to simplify customer adoption and modernization efforts.

  • Drive migration initiatives from legacy API management platforms to Kong.

  • Work closely with customer developers, platform teams, architects, security teams, and executives to solve complex technical and operational challenges.

  • Develop production-grade code, scripts, plugins, CI/CD integrations, Kubernetes automation, and infrastructure tooling as part of customer engagements.

  • Collaborate with Kong Product and Engineering teams to influence roadmap priorities based on real-world customer feedback and implementation learnings.

  • Create reusable best practices, technical assets, reference architectures, documentation, and design patterns to scale delivery excellence across the organization.

  • Support strategic customer initiatives involving AI connectivity, governance, platform modernization, and cloud-native transformation.

 

What You’ll Bring:

Experience

  • 8+ years in customer-facing engineering, platform engineering, professional services, site reliability engineering, or software engineering roles.

  • Strong hands-on software engineering and implementation experience.

  • Experience with API gateways, API management, integrations, or distributed systems platforms.

  • Strong Kubernetes and cloud-native infrastructure expertise.

  • Experience building automation frameworks, deployment tooling, CI/CD pipelines, or migration tooling.

  • Strong proficiency in Linux, networking, cloud infrastructure, and DevOps practices.

  • Experience with major cloud providers including AWS, Azure, or GCP.

  • Programming experience in languages such as Python, Go, Java, JavaScript, or Lua.

  • Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code and automation tooling such as Terraform, Helm, Ansible, or GitOps frameworks.

  • Prior experience working in API Management, Open Source, Middleware, SaaS, or Infrastructure software companies is highly preferred.

Preferred Attributes:

  • Strong builder mindset with the ability to solve complex technical problems with minimal supervision.

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-moving enterprise environments.

  • Passion for working directly with customers and delivering measurable business outcomes.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and executive audiences.

  • Highly organized with strong prioritization and execution skills.

  • Passion for innovation, modern infrastructure, APIs, AI, and cloud-native technologies.

  • Team-oriented with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

 - Own positioning and messaging for AI traffic management — define and evolve the technical narrative for Kong's AI gateway and guardrails capabilities, including LLM routing, policy enforcement, content safety, and multi-agent traffic governance

 - Drive the registry and discovery story — build positioning for AI, MCP, and agent registries, covering listing, registration, governance, and the developer discovery experience

 - Lead technical field enablement for your domain — own product enablement within your domain for Kong Solution Engineers, Customer Success Managers, and other technical field roles 

 - Serve as technical evangelist — represent Kong at industry events, analyst briefings, webinars, and customer conversations; produce technical content including demos, blogs, whitepapers, and reference architectures

 - Produce deep technical content — build demos, reference architectures, technical whitepapers, and documentation-adjacent content that helps architects and security teams evaluate and adopt Kong's approach

 - Partner with product on roadmap narrative — work closely with product management to shape how new capabilities are framed, named, and sequenced for maximum market impact

 - Fuel launches and campaigns — deliver technical positioning, proof points, and demo assets as structured inputs to the AI PMM's launch and campaign motions

 - Mentor and elevate — as the senior-most technical PMM on the team, raise the bar for technical storytelling across the AI portfolio

What You'll Bring:

 - 7+ years of experience in product marketing, product management, or solutions engineering—ideally at an AI/ML platform company

 - Genuine hands-on interest in AI infrastructure: you follow developments in LLM deployment, agentic frameworks, Model Context Protocol, and AI governance; you can speak credibly to AI platform engineers without bluffing

 - Proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into crisp narratives that land with both technical practitioners and C-suite buyers

 - Highly collaborative—you thrive working across Product, Marketing, Sales, and Partner teams

 - Comfortable owning a stage: keynote presentations, analyst briefings, customer roundtables, and demo-heavy sessions are energizing, not intimidating

 - Experience in open-source software, SaaS platforms, and enterprise go-to-market motions strongly preferred

 - Familiarity with the AI connectivity landscape—including awareness of competing and complementary vendors across API gateways, AI observability, vector databases, IPaaS, and agentic orchestration frameworks—is a strong plus

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About the Role:

We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to join Kong’s growing Professional Services organization. This is a highly strategic, customer-facing engineering role focused on helping enterprise customers accelerate adoption of Kong’s API and AI Connectivity platform through hands-on implementation, automation, migration tooling, and solution engineering.

As an FDE, you will work directly alongside customer engineering teams to solve complex technical challenges, accelerate migrations, build reusable automation, and deliver production-grade solutions in real-world enterprise environments. You will operate at the intersection of software engineering, architecture, platform engineering, and customer delivery.

This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy building, coding, solving ambiguous problems, and working directly with customers on mission-critical initiatives involving APIs, AI gateways, service connectivity, modernization, and cloud-native platforms.

You will collaborate closely with Solutions Architects, Engagement Managers, Product Engineering, Customer Success, and Product teams to ensure successful customer outcomes while also influencing Kong’s product direction based on field experience.

Working at Kong is a unique opportunity to make a massive impact on Fortune 50/500 customers as they modernize mission-critical systems for the AI era.

 

What’s in it for you?

Impact

Work directly with some of the world’s largest enterprises to modernize API infrastructure and accelerate AI adoption through Kong’s connectivity platform.

Growth

Accelerate your technical and professional growth through exposure to cutting-edge cloud-native technologies, distributed systems, AI connectivity, automation frameworks, and large-scale enterprise architectures.

Opportunity

Be part of a rapidly growing Professional Services organization that is shaping how enterprises adopt APIs, AI gateways, and modern connectivity platforms globally.

 
 

What You’ll Do:

  • Partner directly with enterprise customers to design, build, and implement Kong-based solutions across cloud, hybrid, and on-premise environments.

  • Lead hands-on implementation efforts for API gateways, AI gateways, service mesh, developer portals, and related connectivity technologies.

  • Build automation frameworks, migration tooling, custom integrations, and reusable accelerators to simplify customer adoption and modernization efforts.

  • Drive migration initiatives from legacy API management platforms to Kong.

  • Work closely with customer developers, platform teams, architects, security teams, and executives to solve complex technical and operational challenges.

  • Develop production-grade code, scripts, plugins, CI/CD integrations, Kubernetes automation, and infrastructure tooling as part of customer engagements.

  • Collaborate with Kong Product and Engineering teams to influence roadmap priorities based on real-world customer feedback and implementation learnings.

  • Create reusable best practices, technical assets, reference architectures, documentation, and design patterns to scale delivery excellence across the organization.

  • Support strategic customer initiatives involving AI connectivity, governance, platform modernization, and cloud-native transformation.

 

What You’ll Bring:

Experience

  • 8+ years in customer-facing engineering, platform engineering, professional services, site reliability engineering, or software engineering roles.

  • Strong hands-on software engineering and implementation experience.

  • Experience with API gateways, API management, integrations, or distributed systems platforms.

  • Strong Kubernetes and cloud-native infrastructure expertise.

  • Experience building automation frameworks, deployment tooling, CI/CD pipelines, or migration tooling.

  • Strong proficiency in Linux, networking, cloud infrastructure, and DevOps practices.

  • Experience with major cloud providers including AWS, Azure, or GCP.

  • Programming experience in languages such as Python, Go, Java, JavaScript, or Lua.

  • Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code and automation tooling such as Terraform, Helm, Ansible, or GitOps frameworks.

  • Prior experience working in API Management, Open Source, Middleware, SaaS, or Infrastructure software companies is highly preferred.

Preferred Attributes:

  • Strong builder mindset with the ability to solve complex technical problems with minimal supervision.

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-moving enterprise environments.

  • Passion for working directly with customers and delivering measurable business outcomes.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and executive audiences.

  • Highly organized with strong prioritization and execution skills.

  • Passion for innovation, modern infrastructure, APIs, AI, and cloud-native technologies.

  • Team-oriented with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

#LI-AW1

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

Technical Support Engineer

Are you ready to join the API revolution?

About the Role:

You will be working at a hectic and fast-paced startup as an engineer in the Technical Support Engineering (TSE) team. This team is responsible for assisting Kong customers in resolving complex technical issues in production and pre-production environments.

You will have the opportunity to work with your teammates and our customers to support many new, leading-edge technologies that solve real challenges. You will work to provide robust feedback and guidance to our product and engineering teams while being a voice for our customers. You want to make our customers and partners successful while strengthening their relationship with Kong. You can make a huge impact and have real ownership for the work you do.

This opportunity is hybrid, with 3 days in the office and 2 days working from home, and requires the candidates to operate either EMEA business hours / US EST Business hours

What You'll Do:

  • Working with top developers from around the world; helping to implement Kong Products and Technologies, including our API Gateway and AI Gateway solutions

  • Leading the investigation of complex technical puzzles and working collaboratively to understand and resolve customer issues via live troubleshooting calls and emails in an enterprise environment

  • Creating knowledge articles to compliment our documentation and enable customers to better understand product use cases

  • Work closely with engineering and product by providing real-time feedback about product performance and customer needs

  • Collaborate closely with other customer-facing teams, including Education, Technical Account Managers, CSMs, and PS for customer issues

  • Participate in bringing innovation within the support team, the company, and our customers by looking for better ways to do the work we do, improve the tools we use, and improve the way we raise the bar on the service we deliver to our Global 5000 customers

  • Provide technical mentorship to other team members and participate in any ad hoc projects

What You'll Bring:

  • You are a voracious learner who loves to dig into technical mysteries and has the creativity to solve complex technical problems

  • You can build relationships with like-minded teammates, smart customers, and global partners

  • Share a growth mindset, learn and adapt quickly

  • Some of the skills that you will regularly use include:

  • REST and RESTful APIs

  • Coding skills (at a minimum, read and troubleshoot code)

  • Cloud technologies, containers, cluster deployment, and management tools like Docker, Docker Swarm, Kubernetes, and others

  • You know your way around web architectures, including HTTP

  • 3+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role

Bonus Points:

Familiarity with DNS, Linux/Unix-type systems, and/or databases

GoLang and/or Lua experience
Experience with scripting languages such as Perl, Ruby, and Shell

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

The is a hybrid role is based in Bangalore.

About the Role:

At Kong, our Sales Development team works closely with our partners in both Sales and Marketing to build fanatical customer enthusiasm around Kong. Sales Development reps are responsible for identifying and qualifying new opportunities for our sales organization. We view our Sales Development program as the best way to turbocharge a long and successful career in sales and view our Sales Development Representatives (SDRs) as the next wave of Account Executives at Kong.

To aid in this endeavor, we invest heavily in the training and development of our team. This includes a 2-week long sales bootcamp, weekly 1-1 mentorship, and global virtual group trainings. By joining our team, you are making an investment in yourself that will accelerate the rest of your sales career.

Our SDRs gain an understanding of our product, community, who we sell to, why they care, and what makes us relevant. They learn how to generate a pipeline quickly and effectively as well as how to achieve a good discovery and qualification. The team is a crucial resource for sales teams across Kong to get great talent from. This helps us scale our teams, as well as ensure that we have a culture of meritocracy.

Being an SDR, is often a first step to jump-starting a career in sales. At Kong, we have a culture that celebrates diversity, fosters growth and enablement, and ensures that we provide our SDRs with the tools and the confidence that they need to grow their careers.

The SDR leadership team has a true understanding of where each SDR is at in their personal development process, and mentors and enables them to ensure that they have the means and opportunity to be considered for their next role. At Kong, we truly believe that if you want to earn your MBA in sales, this is the place to be. As a leadership team, we spend an exorbitant amount of time working in the trenches with our teams to help them fine hone their business and sales acumen and ramp them to productivity, success, and greater roles.

 

What You'll Do:

Market Opportunity - We are on a quest to build a $10b+ software company over the next few years and need YOUR help!

Why APIs Matter? APIs have been enabling innovation for decades!

Strong VC team, Series D, strong year over year revenue growth!

Technical Leadership - We are recognized as the leader in innovation in the connectivity space.

Marco, our CTO/co-founder - “We are the Cisco of L4 and L7” - CUBE Conversation, March 2021

We are the leading innovator in the connectivity space!

Amazing Team & Culture - Come be a "Konger" and find out what we mean.

Great Place to Work Certified in 2020 & 2021

Kong employees exemplify our culture at our 2022 Sales Kickoff

2022 Forbes Cloud 100 Honoree

Building Great Products - Learn why the world's largest companies love our tech!

Kong Named a Leader in the 2023 Gartner Magic Quadrant

Over 250m+ downloads of our open source API gateway! Over 40k+ stars on Github between Kong API and Kong Insomnia!

What you'll be doing: Your First 90 Days

  • By the end of month 1, you will:

  • Have met your new team and had fun playing with some new tools

  • Become a part of the wider Kong family

  • Have had a successful sales boot camp training

  • Have a good understanding of what makes Kong’s product offerings so special

  • Understand how our Sales Development, Marketing and Account Executive teams all work together

  • By the end of month 2, you will:

  • Be comfortable talking to clients on the phone about Kong

  • Have worked with our Account Executive team on your first opportunity

  • Have shadowed a ton of calls and practiced several role-plays

  • Started delivering your ramp quota

  • By the end of month 3, you will:

  • Know our sales funnel inside and out, and feel confident to add value to our sales org

  • Show clear delivery of our sales methodologies

  • Provide insights to both our Sales Development and marketing organizations to help us continue to iterate and improve

  • Delivered against your ramp quota

  • Role Overview & Key Responsibilities:

  • Work with the Sales team to develop inbound and outbound campaigns from idea generation through to qualified call

  • Develop strong sales and product knowledge.

  • Interact with IT and business decision-makers via telephone, video, LinkedIn, and email

  • Update lead and prospect activity in Salesforce to ensure effective lead management

  • Set qualified introductory meetings for the Sales team

  • Nurture early phase opportunities for future pipeline potential

  • Exceed monthly and quarterly opportunity quota

  • Build strong relationships with our marketing team and Account Executives, where we pull together to maximize the win for our business.

  • Invest in your self-development, focusing on the skills and attributes that will make you successful in your core role and get you set for future success

  • And any additional tasks required by the manager.

     

What You'll Bring:

  • 1 year or more of strong sales or customer-facing experience.

  • A self-starter with a track record of hitting and exceeding goals.

  • A ‘hunter’ mentality - comfortable prospecting, cold-calling, and following up on incoming leads and a strong desire to win.

  • Ability and willingness to learn, react to and share lessons learned across the organisation.

  • Open to feedback and can apply to your daily workflow.

  • Outstanding communication skills including both phone and written communication as well as active listening.

  • An extraordinary character with an incredible drive for success, a high work ethic, curious by nature, and obsessed with smashing sales goals.

  • Validated time leadership skills and ability to work independently and through coaching.

  • Desire to work in a driven and fast-paced environment.

  • Passionate about cutting-edge technology with the aptitude to learn new and exciting IT software products, as well as, understand business critical solutions quickly.

At Kong, our Sales Development team works closely with our partners in both Sales and Marketing to build fanatical customer enthusiasm around Kong. Sales Development reps are responsible for identifying and qualifying new opportunities for our sales organization. We view our Sales Development program as the best way to turbocharge a long and successful career in sales and view our Sales Development Representatives (SDRs) as the next wave of Account Executives at Kong.

To aid in this endeavor, we invest heavily in the training and development of our team. This includes a 2-week long sales bootcamp, weekly 1-1 mentorship, and global virtual group trainings. By joining our team, you are making an investment in yourself that will accelerate the rest of your sales career.

Our SDRs gain an understanding of our product, community, who we sell to, why they care, and what makes us relevant. They learn how to generate a pipeline quickly and effectively as well as how to achieve a good discovery and qualification. The team is a crucial resource for sales teams across Kong to get great talent from. This helps us scale our teams, as well as ensure that we have a culture of meritocracy.

Being an SDR, is often a first step to jump-starting a career in sales. At Kong, we have a culture that celebrates diversity, fosters growth and enablement, and ensures that we provide our SDRs with the tools and the confidence that they need to grow their careers.

The SDR leadership team has a true understanding of where each SDR is at in their personal development process, and mentors and enables them to ensure that they have the means and opportunity to be considered for their next role. At Kong, we truly believe that if you want to earn your MBA in sales, this is the place to be. As a leadership team, we spend an exorbitant amount of time working in the trenches with our teams to help them fine hone their business and sales acumen and ramp them to productivity, success, and greater roles.
