jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive, Benelux
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About The Role:

We are seeking a committed Enterprise Account Executive with a successful background in sales and account management, ideally within open source or similar enterprise software environments. In this role, you will be a key driver of our growth strategy, directly impacting the stability and expansion of our recurring revenue. This position is ideal for a sales professional who has experience in landing new clients, retaining existing customers, and driving account expansion for early-stage enterprise products in a dynamic, entrepreneurial setting.

What You’ll Do:

Develop and execute sales strategies to target enterprise customers, focusing on building and maintaining a robust pipeline that drives long-term growth.

  • Own the entire sales cycle, from prospecting and initial outreach to contract negotiations and closing deals, while consistently meeting or exceeding revenue targets.

  • Collaborate with internal teams, including product, marketing, and customer success, to ensure a seamless sales experience and alignment on customer needs.

  • Identify customer pain points and align our solutions to address these, delivering customized product demos and presentations tailored to their specific business needs.

  • Build and nurture relationships with C-level executives and key decision-makers within target accounts, establishing yourself as a trusted advisor and ensuring customer satisfaction and retention.

  • Lead account planning efforts by researching potential customers, understanding industry trends, and developing strategies to win new business and grow existing accounts.

  • Monitor and manage sales activities and results, accurately forecasting opportunities and keeping detailed records of interactions and progress in CRM systems.

  • Stay updated on industry trends, competitor offerings, and market changes to position our product effectively and maintain a competitive edge.

  • Contribute to business growth initiatives, providing feedback to product and marketing teams to influence product development and go-to-market strategies.

  • Represent Kong with professionalism, acting as a brand ambassador at industry events, conferences, and customer meetings.

What You’ll Bring:

  • 7+ years of experience in enterprise sales (>1k employees), with a proven track record of closing complex deals in a SaaS, cloud, or enterprise software environment.

  • Demonstrated success in selling to large enterprises, particularly to senior-level executives and across multiple departments.

  • Strong consultative selling skills, with the ability to understand customer needs and present compelling solutions that drive business outcomes.

  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills, capable of managing high-stakes conversations and building lasting relationships with stakeholders.

  • A results-driven mindset, with a passion for meeting and exceeding sales goals and revenue targets.

  • Experience working with CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce) and leveraging data to forecast accurately and track sales metrics.

  • Knowledge of open-source software, APIs, or infrastructure software is highly advantageous.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment, taking ownership of your sales territory and adapting to changing market dynamics.

  • Analytical and strategic thinking, with a knack for identifying business growth opportunities and devising plans to capitalize on them.

jobs.descriptionHtml:

About the Role:

As part of our Sales organization, Kong's Solution Engineers play an instrumental role in our continued growth and success as they align with our Account Executive team and lead the technical sale cycle with both new and existing customers. This is a position supporting Enterprise & Strategic accounts within the UAE region. If you are someone who is motivated by the opportunity to drive new business while learning and evangelizing our cutting-edge technology, we want to speak to you!

 

What You'll Do:

  • Support field sales in helping customers understand the value of the Kong API Management & Connectivity solutions.

  • Grow trusted client relationships throughout the entire sales lifecycle from initial discovery/ requirement gathering, to product reviews/ demos, and into production.

  • Support PoCs throughout the entire evaluation process.

  • Onboard and train new customers and establish revenue potential with existing customers.

  • Coordinate with support, product, and engineering teams to prioritize customer needs and ensure 100% satisfaction across assigned set of accounts.

  • Create technical documentation for DevOps, implementations, and services engagements.

  • Participate in creative lead generating activities such as creating blog posts, leading webinars, working industry events, etc.

  • And any additional tasks required by manager.

 

What You'll Bring:

  • 7+ years of pre-sales Solution Engineering or relevant experience at a SaaS, Open-source or Enterprise Software company.

  • Experience working with Open-source technology.

  • Foundational knowledge/ understanding of API Management & Integration, Cloud computing trends, Open-source business models.

  • Confident ability to present and lead discussions with C or Director level executives as well as Product Managers and Engineers.

  • Enthusiasm for working in a high profile, fast-paced startup culture.

 

Bonus Points:

  • Previous experience with API Gateway or Service Mesh is preferred.

  • Experience with Docker or Kubernetes.

  • Strong knowledge of NGINX, HTTP, AWS, Postgres, and/ or Cassandra.

  • Fluency working on Linux OSes.

  • Familiarity with DevOps and CD/CI pipeline.

  • Any knowledge on DCOS/Mesos and Docker Swarm is a plus.

jobs.title: Senior Corporate Counsel, Commercial (US East)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About the Role:

We are looking for an experienced attorney to join as an early member of Kong’s commercial legal team, responsible for helping support Kong’s strategic sales growth in the Americas East region and provide support to the AMER team as it grows. In this role, you will be a trusted strategic partner to the Americas East revenue team. You will draft, structure and negotiate customer contracts with some of the world’s biggest brands in financial services, technology, e-commerce and other industries. You will also play a primary role in supporting our US federal government customers. You will be called on to assess legal and business risks, make sound decisions, and provide advice on a broad range of issues in areas such as privacy, security, open-source software and intellectual property, and assist with other issues as they come up. You will report to Kong’s Sr. Director, Head of Global Commercial Legal. The position is based in New York, Chicago, Austin TX, or Toronto.

 

What You'll Do:

  • Lead complex SaaS and on-premises commercial negotiations

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to Kong’s Americas sales team, primarily in the US East market

  • Review, draft, and negotiate a wide variety of other commercial agreements

  • Help ensure compliance with a variety of laws and regulations impacting our SaaS and on-premises offerings, including regarding artificial intelligence, intellectual property, privacy, security and government contracting

  • Partner with Finance, Revenue Operations and Customer Assurance to support the end-to-end contract close process

  • Advise internal teams on legal matters and provide general commercial legal advice

  • Assisting with the development of our positions with respect to artificial intelligence and our products as they relate to our customers’ infrastructure.

 

What You’ll Bring:

  • Law degree, and member in good standing of the applicable state bar or eligible to be a registered in-house counsel

  • Minimum 7-10 years of experience practicing law both in private practice and in-house, preferably with late-stage private and/or early-stage public technology companies

  • Demonstrated experience in negotiating and closing complex SaaS and software contracts with large, sophisticated customers

  • Collaborative, and willing to build something together as a team

  • Experience with federal government procurement and customers

  • Great judgment, and an ability to build and maintain strong professional relationships within the company, with customers, and others

  • Working knowledge of intellectual property, data governance and information security/privacy matters

  • High professional and personal standards, and a commitment to inclusiveness

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

About the Role:

Kong is The AI Connectivity Company. Our platform sits at the centre of how enterprises manage APIs, AI agents, and the infrastructure connecting them and we’re scaling fast. The ADR role is the front line of that growth. The accounts you open today are the expansion stories of tomorrow.

 

As a Commercial Outbound ADR, you’ll identify and qualify new business opportunities across the EMEA commercial segment, working closely with our Sales and Marketing teams. This isn’t just a job, it’s the best way to fast-track a long career in tech sales.

 

We invest heavily in our people: a 4-week sales bootcamp, weekly 1-1 mentorship, continuous training throughout your tenure, and a leadership team that actually gets in the trenches with you. If you want an MBA in sales, this is the place to earn it.

 

Your first 90 days

  • Month 1: Meet your team, complete bootcamp, and fall in love with what Kong actually does.

  • Month 2: Pick up the phone with confidence, master our tech stach (Nooks, Claude, Gemini, Sumble, Lusha etc) and work your first live opportunity, and hit your ramp quota.

  • Month 3: Own your funnel, share what’s working, and what needs optimisation.

     

What You’ll Do:

  • Build and run outbound campaigns end-to-end, from idea to qualified meeting

  • Engage decision-makers across phone, email, LinkedIn, and video

  • Partner closely with AEs and Marketing, you’re a connector, not just a top-of-funnel rep

  • Keep Salesforce clean and your pipeline tighter, process matters here

  • Utilise AI to boost productivity, work at pace and personalise your messaging

  • Invest in your own development, your manager will meet you where you are and help you get to what’s next

 

What You’ll Bring:

  • Some experience in a customer-facing or sales role — internships, retail, or hospitality count if you can show you know how to build rapport and drive outcomes

  • A hunter mentality, you’re not waiting to be handed leads, you go and find them

  • High coachability, you take feedback well, apply it fast, and ask for more

  • Strong communicator, clear and confident in writing and on a call

  • Genuine curiosity about technology - you don’t need to be an engineer, but you want to understand what Kong does and why it matters

  • Languages: Fluency in German is essential.

Why Kong?

  • Be part of the company defining the future of AI connectivity. APIs and agents run on Kong

  • Real career development - our ADRs are the next wave of AEs in the tech, and our leadership team is invested in making that happen

  • Hybrid from our central London office - walking distance from Bank Station and London Bridge, 2–3 days a week in the office. A beautiful location to work from in Summer

  • Competitive comp, benefits, and a team that shows up with integrity, energy, and purpose

 

Every day, we raise the bar of what great looks like. Ready to help set it?

About the Role:

We are looking for an experienced sales professional, ideally with open source experience who will be selling into global enterprise accounts. The ideal candidate has been a part of the sales efforts for other early-stage enterprise products in an entrepreneurial setting. The Enterprise Account Executive will be integral to our growth plan and in acquiring new customers. Kong’s Account Executive will be the primary point of contact and the face of Kong for our prospects.

  • Provide account leadership and direction in the pre- and post-sales process and contribute to analysis on wins/losses.

  • Ability to travel to customer sites as required (30% - 50%).

  • Methodical approach to sales and pipeline generation

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer - Volcano
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About The Role:

Kong is building Project Volcano, an internal developer platform purpose-built for Kong's engineering ecosystem. Volcano will provide teams with on-demand preview environments, edge deployments, managed PostgreSQL, auth, realtime, and storage APIs all deeply integrated with Kong products.

As the Senior SRE for Volcano, you will be the reliability voice for this platform. This role is a strategic initiative driven by the Office of the CTO (OCTO). You will partner directly with engineering leadership to define the platform's reliability posture. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role with direct influence on Kong's next generation developer platform.

 

What You'll Do:

  • Own reliability for Volcano end-to-end: Define and drive SLOs, error budgets, and incident response practices for all Volcano services — edge deployments, managed Postgres, auth, realtime, storage, and the control plane.

  • Contribute to the platform's infrastructure: Design and build the multi-region Kubernetes infrastructure, networking, and data plane that powers Volcano's edge deployment pipeline and backend-as-a-service capabilities.

  • Build the GitOps and CI/CD backbone: Establish deployment automation, canary pipelines, and preview environment provisioning using ArgoCD, Helm, and Terraform/Terragrunt — setting patterns the broader team will follow.

  • Scale managed data services: Design, operate, and harden multi-tenant PostgreSQL clusters, Redis caching layers, and object storage — with a focus on data isolation, performance, and disaster recovery.

  • Drive observability from day one: Instrument every Volcano service with meaningful SLIs; build dashboards, alerts, and runbooks using Datadog, Prometheus, and Grafana before services go live, not after incidents.

  • Lead cross-functional reliability work: Collaborate with the OCTO team, product engineering, and security to bake reliability and compliance into Volcano's architecture — not bolt it on later.

  • Evaluate and adopt emerging technologies: Given Volcano's greenfield nature, evaluate and make architectural decisions on edge runtimes, serverless compute, vector databases, and AI-native infrastructure components.

 

What You'll Bring:

  • BS in Computer Science or equivalent; substantial experience at Staff or Principal IC level in SRE/Platform Engineering.

  • Proven track record building SRE or platform engineering practices for developer-facing platforms or PaaS/SaaS products — ideally at greenfield stage.

  • Kubernetes expertise: multi-tenant cluster design, networking (CNI, service mesh, ingress), autoscaling, and security hardening.

jobs.title: Team Lead, Account Development Representatives
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About the Role:

Kong is hiring an ADR Team Lead to support our NEMEA region: the UK, Benelux, and Nordics. This is a player-coach role. You'll carry your own pipeline targets while taking an active hand in developing the team around you, especially the newer ADRs still finding their footing.

You'll work closely with, and report into, the Senior Manager for NEMEA. You're shaping how the team operates, not running it solo. Think of this as a high-impact individual contributor role with a leadership layer built in: the natural next step for an ADR who's ready to start making other people better, not just themselves.

Our NEMEA team is already strong. Driven, independent, hitting their numbers. What they need isn't more oversight. They need someone who sharpens how the team works, especially around process and tooling, while making sure newer reps get the support to ramp fast.

You'll report to Oscar Winberg. He moves fast, sets a high bar, and expects people to bring solutions, not just flag problems. He's direct, so you'll always know exactly where you stand, and he expects that same directness back: if you disagree, he wants the pushback, backed by data, not silence. Earn his trust and he'll hand you real ownership. What he won't do is hand-hold, so this role suits someone who'd rather be given room to run than told exactly what to do.

What You'll Do:

Carry your own number. You'll hit your own pipeline targets as an active ADR. Your activity and results set the standard for everyone watching. You'll contribute to weekly forecasting alongside the Senior Manager.

Support newer ADRs. You'll be the first point of contact for less tenured reps, helping them ramp faster and build good habits early. You'll help with onboarding alongside the Senior Manager and Enablement, and run regular 1:1s with newer ADRs. Different reps need different things from you, so you'll read where each person is and adjust your coaching accordingly rather than running the same playbook on everyone. You'll help build individual development plans grounded in a real read of each rep's attitude, process, and results, and you'll flag underperformance early, with context, instead of letting it fester.

Coach and upskill the team. You'll support team coaching sessions: live dialling, pitch practice, feedback loops. You'll run or contribute to upskilling initiatives, on your own or with Enablement. You'll share what's working, best practices, sequences, outbound approaches, with the wider team, and give direct, specific feedback often, recognizing strong work and not letting bad habits slide.

Sharpen process and tooling. You'll help spot where the team's workflows and tooling could run more efficiently, and support the Senior Manager in rolling out improvements without stripping reps of their autonomy. You'll be the go-to person for best practice on Salesforce, Outreach, and the team's automation tools.

Contribute to the wider GTM motion. You'll keep strong alignment with your AE partners and take part in pipe review cadences. You'll support the Senior Manager in preparing performance updates and regional insights, and join bi-weekly RD cadences where it makes sense.

What You'll Bring:

  • Hands-on ADR or SDR experience. You know what this job feels like from the inside, not just what it looks like from a deck.

  • A real coach's instinct. You get energy from making other people better, not just from hitting your own number.

  • The ability to juggle competing priorities without dropping the ball. Your own quota, coaching newer reps, and process work will all pull on your time in the same week, and you know how to decide what actually matters right now.

  • Strong time management. This is one we screen for directly, not something we assume comes with experience.

  • A bias for building. You spot what needs fixing and go build it, rather than working only through a list of tasks someone else handed you.

  • Analytical rigor. You make calls based on data, not gut feel, and you're comfortable being specific about why a number moved, including when that number is going the wrong way.

  • A track record of top-tier performance that holds up on both counts: the day-to-day discipline that drives it (activity, sequence execution, pipeline hygiene), and the results that discipline produces, quarter over quarter, not just once.

  • Real trust with your AE and RD partners, earned through consistency, not just alignment on paper.

  • Transparency, especially with leadership, especially when something isn't on track. We'd rather hear it early than find out later.

  • The kind of presence the team actually looks up to, not just reports to.

  • Comfort in an allbound model with a heavy outbound emphasis.

  • Self-awareness and a genuine investment in growing as a leader.

  • Language skills relevant to the UK, Benelux, or Nordics are a bonus, not a requirement.

Culture and Value:

The EMEA SDR team are weather makers. We don't wait for opportunity, we create it. We're accountable, relentless, and we invest in each other like no other team does.

  • Relentless. Energy and intention every day. Every challenge is a chance to get stronger.

  • Character. Good humans first. Integrity, humility, and keeping our word.

  • Together. No one gets left behind. Differences make us better, not harder to manage.

  • Truth. Radical honesty. We say the hard things with care. That's how we move fast.

  • Accountable. We own our results, bias toward action, and don't wait to be told.

  • Pioneering. We take up space, experiment, and bring creative thinking to every challenge.

In NEMEA specifically, we operate in mature markets. We don't manufacture urgency, we earn entry by knowing the landscape better than the prospect does. We're pipeline gardeners: patient, precise, persistent.

"We don't book meetings. We build pipeline."

About the Role:

Kong is hiring an ADR Team Lead to support our NEMEA region: the UK, Benelux, and Nordics. This is a player-coach role. You'll carry your own pipeline targets while taking an active hand in developing the team around you, especially the newer ADRs still finding their footing.

You'll work closely with, and report into, the Senior Manager for NEMEA. You're shaping how the team operates, not running it solo. Think of this as a high-impact individual contributor role with a leadership layer built in: the natural next step for an ADR who's ready to start making other people better, not just themselves.

Our NEMEA team is already strong. Driven, independent, hitting their numbers. What they need isn't more oversight. They need someone who sharpens how the team works, especially around process and tooling, while making sure newer reps get the support to ramp fast.

You'll report to Oscar Winberg. He moves fast, sets a high bar, and expects people to bring solutions, not just flag problems. He's direct, so you'll always know exactly where you stand, and he expects that same directness back: if you disagree, he wants the pushback, backed by data, not silence. Earn his trust and he'll hand you real ownership. What he won't do is hand-hold, so this role suits someone who'd rather be given room to run than told exactly what to do.



What You'll Do:

Carry your own number. You'll hit your own pipeline targets as an active ADR. Your activity and results set the standard for everyone watching. You'll contribute to weekly forecasting alongside the Senior Manager.

Support newer ADRs. You'll be the first point of contact for less tenured reps, helping them ramp faster and build good habits early. You'll help with onboarding alongside the Senior Manager and Enablement, and run regular 1:1s with newer ADRs. Different reps need different things from you, so you'll read where each person is and adjust your coaching accordingly rather than running the same playbook on everyone. You'll help build individual development plans grounded in a real read of each rep's attitude, process, and results, and you'll flag underperformance early, with context, instead of letting it fester.

Coach and upskill the team. You'll support team coaching sessions: live dialling, pitch practice, feedback loops. You'll run or contribute to upskilling initiatives, on your own or with Enablement. You'll share what's working, best practices, sequences, outbound approaches, with the wider team, and give direct, specific feedback often, recognizing strong work and not letting bad habits slide.

Sharpen process and tooling. You'll help spot where the team's workflows and tooling could run more efficiently, and support the Senior Manager in rolling out improvements without stripping reps of their autonomy. You'll be the go-to person for best practice on Salesforce, Outreach, and the team's automation tools.

Contribute to the wider GTM motion. You'll keep strong alignment with your AE partners and take part in pipe review cadences. You'll support the Senior Manager in preparing performance updates and regional insights, and join bi-weekly RD cadences where it makes sense.



What You'll Bring:

 - Hands-on ADR or SDR experience. You know what this job feels like from the inside, not just what it looks like from a deck.

 - A real coach's instinct. You get energy from making other people better, not just from hitting your own number.

 - The ability to juggle competing priorities without dropping the ball. Your own quota, coaching newer reps, and process work will all pull on your time in the same week, and you know how to decide what actually matters right now.

 - Strong time management. This is one we screen for directly, not something we assume comes with experience.

 - A bias for building. You spot what needs fixing and go build it, rather than working only through a list of tasks someone else handed you.

 - Analytical rigor. You make calls based on data, not gut feel, and you're comfortable being specific about why a number moved, including when that number is going the wrong way.

 - A track record of top-tier performance that holds up on both counts: the day-to-day discipline that drives it (activity, sequence execution, pipeline hygiene), and the results that discipline produces, quarter over quarter, not just once.

 - Real trust with your AE and RD partners, earned through consistency, not just alignment on paper.

 - Transparency, especially with leadership, especially when something isn't on track. We'd rather hear it early than find out later.

 - The kind of presence the team actually looks up to, not just reports to.

 - Comfort in an allbound model with a heavy outbound emphasis.

 - Self-awareness and a genuine investment in growing as a leader.

 - Language skills relevant to the UK, Benelux, or Nordics are a bonus, not a requirement.



Culture and Value:

The EMEA SDR team are weather makers. We don't wait for opportunity, we create it. We're accountable, relentless, and we invest in each other like no other team does.

 - Relentless. Energy and intention every day. Every challenge is a chance to get stronger.

 - Character. Good humans first. Integrity, humility, and keeping our word.

 - Together. No one gets left behind. Differences make us better, not harder to manage.

 - Truth. Radical honesty. We say the hard things with care. That's how we move fast.

 - Accountable. We own our results, bias toward action, and don't wait to be told.

 - Pioneering. We take up space, experiment, and bring creative thinking to every challenge.

In NEMEA specifically, we operate in mature markets. We don't manufacture urgency, we earn entry by knowing the landscape better than the prospect does. We're pipeline gardeners: patient, precise, persistent.

"We don't book meetings. We build pipeline."

jobs.title: Staff Solutions Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About the Role:

Are you ready to sit at the epicenter of the API and AI connectivity revolution? As a Staff Solutions Engineer at Kong, you won’t just be selling a platform — you’ll be a trusted technical advisor helping the world’s most innovative enterprises architect secure, scalable API ecosystems while navigating the transition into the agentic AI era. Kong sits at the intersection of API management and AI connectivity, and you’ll be the person who makes that story real for customers.

 

What You’ll Do:

  • Support field sales in helping customers understand the value of the Kong API and AI connectivity platform.

  • Conduct discovery conversations to understand customer requirements and map them to Kong solutions, from initial product reviews through to production.

  • Support POCs throughout the entire evaluation process, owning technical validation and stakeholder alignment.

  • Ensure customer satisfaction across your assigned set of accounts.

  • Collaborate with support, product, and engineering teams to advocate for customer needs.

  • Create technical documentation for DevOps, implementations, and services engagements.

  • Lead and support API Management and AI Goverance evaluations, including scoping API/AI use cases, LLM traffic management, and governance requirements.

  • Deliver demonstrations of Kong’s API & AI governance and agentic connectivity capabilities, including Model Context Protocol (MCP) governance, semantic caching, prompt guardrails, and shadow AI detection.

  • Run API & AI-focused Technical Feasibility Workshops (TFWs) to validate Kong’s fit for modern and/or AI/agentic architectures.

  • Own the technical strategy for complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals from qualification through close.

  • Mentor and coach junior SEs on technical skills, discovery methods, and deal strategy.

  • Drive thought leadership by authoring technical blogs, hosting webinars, speaking at industry events and conferences such as AWS re:Invent, Google Next, API & AI summit, and regional events

  • Influence product direction by synthesizing customer feedback and market signals into actionable input for the product team.

  • And any additional tasks required by manager.

 

What You’ll Bring:

  • 7+ years of software engineering and/or solutions engineering experience at a SaaS, open source, or enterprise software company.

  • Proven track record owning complex, enterprise-level deals with multiple technical and executive stakeholders.

  • Experience mentoring or coaching other SEs or technical team members.

  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud-native platforms.

  • Experience with REST and GraphQL APIs, CI/CD pipelines, and API security patterns (OAuth2, OIDC, mTLS).

  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tooling — Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, OpenAI Codex, or equivalent is required.

  • Working knowledge of AI/LLM architectures, including model routing, rate limiting, semantic caching, and prompt governance.

  • Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agentic AI patterns.

  • Solid understanding of cloud computing trends and open source business models.

  • Strong listener and communicator — you can confidently lead discussions with engineers, architects, and executives.

  • Enthusiasm for working in a high-profile, fast-paced environment at the intersection of API and AI connectivity.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About the Role:

• Work with the Sales team to develop and lead inbound and outbound campaigns from idea generation through to qualified call

• Develop strong sales and product knowledge and interact with IT and business decision-makers via telephone, video, LinkedIn, and email

• Update lead and prospect activity in Salesforce to ensure effective lead management

• Set qualified introductory meetings for the Sales team

• Nurture early phase opportunities for future pipeline potential

• Exceed monthly and quarterly opportunity quota

• Build strong relationships with our marketing team and Account Executives, where we pull together to maximize the win for our business

• Invest in your self-development, focusing on the skills and attributes that will make you successful in your core role and get you set for future success

• And any additional tasks required by the manager

 

What You'll Do: Your First 90 Days

By the end of month 1, you will:

• Have met your new team and had fun playing with some new tools

• Become a part of the wider Kong family

• Have had a successful sales boot camp training

• Have a good understanding of what makes Kong’s product offerings so special

• Understand how our Account Development, Marketing and Account Executive teams all work together

By the end of month 2, you will:

• Be comfortable talking to clients on the phone about Kong

• Have worked with our Account Executive team on your first opportunity

• Have shadowed a ton of calls and practiced several role plays

• Started delivering your ramp quota

 

By the end of month 3, you will:

• Know our sales funnel inside and out, and feel confident to add value to our sales org

• Show clear delivery of our sales methodologies

• Provide insights to both our Account Development and marketing organizations to help us to continue to iterate and improve

• Delivered against your ramp quota

 

What You'll Bring:

• 1-2+ years of strong sales or customer-facing experience

• A self-starter with a track record of hitting and exceeding goals

• A ‘hunter’ mentality - comfortable prospecting, cold-calling, and following up on incoming leads and a strong desire to win.

• Ability and willingness to learn, react to and share lessons learned across the organisation.

• Open to feedback and can apply to your daily workflow.

• Outstanding communication skills including both phone and written communication as well as active listening

• An extraordinary character with an incredible drive for success, high work ethic, curious by nature, and obsessed with smashing sales goals

• Validated time leadership skills and ability to work independently and through coaching

• Desire to work in a driven and fast-paced environment

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Professional Services
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

AI traffic is about to outrun API traffic the same way API traffic outran human traffic. Come lead the team that gets enterprises through that transition.

If you don't think you meet every bullet below, apply anyway. Nobody checks every box — we're looking for people who are strong in a few areas and hungry in the rest.

About the Role:

Kong is the connectivity layer of AI. We're a 6-time Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader and a Forrester Wave Leader, running in production at Fortune 500 scale. Every enterprise moving from “we're piloting AI” to “AI is in production” runs into the same wall: governance, security, and connectivity for a traffic pattern nobody built for. That's the opportunity in front of this team, and it's why Professional Services is one of the fastest-growing parts of this company right now.

We're hiring a Professional Services Manager to lead a team of Forward Deployed Engineers and Engagement Managers across Kong's US Professional Services organization. This is a leadership role, not a delivery role: you're directly responsible for delivery outcomes, staffing, and the growth of the people who sit hands-on with customer engineering teams every day.

You own the full engagement lifecycle for your book of business — staffing the right FDE and Engagement Manager on every account, holding the team to go-live dates and technical quality, and driving resolution personally on the highest-risk or highest-value accounts. You're operating at the intersection of people leadership, technical delivery, and enterprise account management, and you're judged on outcomes, not activity.

We want leaders who've done the implementation work themselves and now want to multiply that impact through a team: coach the engineers, coach the engagement managers, clear the blockers neither of them can clear alone, and build the delivery muscle that lets Kong keep pace with enterprise demand for API and AI connectivity.

You'll work daily with Solutions Architects, Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Product Engineering — scoping engagements correctly before they land on your team, and feeding what you learn in the field straight back into how Kong builds and sells.

This is a rare seat: AI connectivity is a land grab right now, and the person who builds this team's delivery model in the next 18 months owns a track record that doesn't come around twice.

Impact

Lead the team that turns Kong's platform into production reality for some of the world's largest enterprises — the ones deciding right now how AI gets governed, secured, and scaled across their business.

Growth

Build your leadership craft against the fastest-moving category in enterprise software: AI connectivity, cloud-native architecture, and distributed systems at Fortune 500 scale. Prove out this team's model and the case for more scope writes itself.

Opportunity

Join a Professional Services organization growing as fast as the AI adoption curve it's built to serve — market-leading credibility behind every conversation you walk into, and a direct hand in building the delivery model while it's still being written.

What You'll Do:

  • Manage and grow a team of Forward Deployed Engineers and Engagement Managers — hiring, coaching, career development, and performance management.

  • Own delivery outcomes across your book of business: go-live dates, technical quality, and customer satisfaction. Report on them with the same rigor you'd demand from your team.

  • Staff the right FDE and Engagement Manager to every engagement based on account complexity, technical scope, and team capacity.

  • Be the senior escalation point on at-risk or high-complexity engagements — drive resolution and direct the team's response personally.

  • Run your team's operating cadence: staffing reviews, at-risk reviews, 1:1s, and status reporting up to Professional Services leadership.

  • Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and Solutions Architecture to scope new engagements accurately and take clean handoffs from pre-sale to delivery.

  • Set and enforce delivery standards across your team — reusable accelerators, reference architectures, and best practices that outlive any single engagement.

  • Feed what your team learns in the field back to Kong Product and Engineering — real customer signal shapes our roadmap.

  • Lead your team's work on the strategic initiatives that matter most right now: AI connectivity, governance, platform modernization, and cloud-native transformation.

What You'll Bring:

Experience

  • 8+ years in customer-facing engineering, professional services, or platform engineering, including 2+ years directly managing a technical, customer-facing team.

  • A track record of delivery leadership in API gateways, API management, integrations, or distributed systems platforms — deep enough that you can direct and evaluate your team's work, not just review it.

  • Experience managing staffing, capacity, and prioritization across a portfolio of concurrent enterprise engagements.

  • Strong Kubernetes and cloud-native infrastructure fluency — enough to unblock your team and hold your own with customer architects and executives.

  • Experience with major cloud providers: AWS, Azure, or GCP.

  • Comfort directing and evaluating automation frameworks, deployment tooling, CI/CD pipelines, or migration tooling built by your team.

  • Prior experience in API Management, Open Source, Middleware, SaaS, or Infrastructure software companies is a strong plus.

Preferred Attributes

  • A decisive leadership mindset — you make the staffing and prioritization call and drive it to resolution without needing to do the work yourself.

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-moving enterprise environments where the right call today beats the perfect call next week.

  • A genuine passion for growing engineers and engagement managers into their next role — this job is measured in the careers you build, not just the accounts you save.

  • Excellent communication across technical and executive audiences, internal and customer-facing.

  • Highly organized, with strong prioritization and execution across a multi-account portfolio.

  • Real enthusiasm for AI, modern infrastructure, and cloud-native technology — this team is living the shift, not reading about it.

  • A strong sense of ownership for outcomes that aren't always fully in your control — that's the job.

#LI-KH1

jobs.title: Team Lead, Account Development Representatives
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About the Role:

Kong is hiring an ADR Team Lead to support our NEMEA region: the UK, Benelux, and Nordics. This is a player-coach role. You'll carry your own pipeline targets while taking an active hand in developing the team around you, especially the newer ADRs still finding their footing.

You'll work closely with, and report into, the Senior Manager for NEMEA. You're shaping how the team operates, not running it solo. Think of this as a high-impact individual contributor role with a leadership layer built in: the natural next step for an ADR who's ready to start making other people better, not just themselves.

Our NEMEA team is already strong. Driven, independent, hitting their numbers. What they need isn't more oversight. They need someone who sharpens how the team works, especially around process and tooling, while making sure newer reps get the support to ramp fast.

You'll report to Oscar Winberg. He moves fast, sets a high bar, and expects people to bring solutions, not just flag problems. He's direct, so you'll always know exactly where you stand, and he expects that same directness back: if you disagree, he wants the pushback, backed by data, not silence. Earn his trust and he'll hand you real ownership. What he won't do is hand-hold, so this role suits someone who'd rather be given room to run than told exactly what to do.

What You'll Do:

Carry your own number. You'll hit your own pipeline targets as an active ADR. Your activity and results set the standard for everyone watching. You'll contribute to weekly forecasting alongside the Senior Manager.

Support newer ADRs. You'll be the first point of contact for less tenured reps, helping them ramp faster and build good habits early. You'll help with onboarding alongside the Senior Manager and Enablement, and run regular 1:1s with newer ADRs. Different reps need different things from you, so you'll read where each person is and adjust your coaching accordingly rather than running the same playbook on everyone. You'll help build individual development plans grounded in a real read of each rep's attitude, process, and results, and you'll flag underperformance early, with context, instead of letting it fester.

Coach and upskill the team. You'll support team coaching sessions: live dialling, pitch practice, feedback loops. You'll run or contribute to upskilling initiatives, on your own or with Enablement. You'll share what's working, best practices, sequences, outbound approaches, with the wider team, and give direct, specific feedback often, recognizing strong work and not letting bad habits slide.

Sharpen process and tooling. You'll help spot where the team's workflows and tooling could run more efficiently, and support the Senior Manager in rolling out improvements without stripping reps of their autonomy. You'll be the go-to person for best practice on Salesforce, Outreach, and the team's automation tools.

Contribute to the wider GTM motion. You'll keep strong alignment with your AE partners and take part in pipe review cadences. You'll support the Senior Manager in preparing performance updates and regional insights, and join bi-weekly RD cadences where it makes sense.

What You'll Bring:

  • Hands-on ADR or SDR experience. You know what this job feels like from the inside, not just what it looks like from a deck.

  • A real coach's instinct. You get energy from making other people better, not just from hitting your own number.

  • The ability to juggle competing priorities without dropping the ball. Your own quota, coaching newer reps, and process work will all pull on your time in the same week, and you know how to decide what actually matters right now.

  • Strong time management. This is one we screen for directly, not something we assume comes with experience.

  • A bias for building. You spot what needs fixing and go build it, rather than working only through a list of tasks someone else handed you.

  • Analytical rigor. You make calls based on data, not gut feel, and you're comfortable being specific about why a number moved, including when that number is going the wrong way.

  • You touch the line. Your metrics back it up: leading indicators (activity, sequence execution, pipeline hygiene) and lagging indicators (quota attainment, pipeline generated) that show a track record of real discipline, not one good quarter.

  • Real trust with your AE and RD partners, earned through consistency, not just alignment on paper.

  • Transparency, especially with leadership, especially when something isn't on track. We'd rather hear it early than find out later.

  • The kind of presence the team actually looks up to, not just reports to.

  • Comfort in an allbound model with a heavy outbound emphasis.

  • Self-awareness and a genuine investment in growing as a leader.

  • Language skills relevant to the UK, Benelux, or Nordics are a bonus, not a requirement.

We'll consider strong internal and external candidates. For external hires, the bar is high: we're looking for someone who brings something genuinely differentiated.

Culture and Values:

The EMEA SDR team are weather makers. We don't wait for opportunity, we create it. We're accountable, relentless, and we invest in each other like no other team does.

  • Relentless. Energy and intention every day. Every challenge is a chance to get stronger.

  • Character. Good humans first. Integrity, humility, and keeping our word.

  • Together. No one gets left behind. Differences make us better, not harder to manage.

  • Truth. Radical honesty. We say the hard things with care. That's how we move fast.

  • Accountable. We own our results, bias toward action, and don't wait to be told.

  • Pioneering. We take up space, experiment, and bring creative thinking to every challenge.

In NEMEA specifically, we operate in mature markets. We don't manufacture urgency, we earn entry by knowing the landscape better than the prospect does. We're pipeline gardeners: patient, precise, persistent.

"We don't book meetings. We build pipeline."

This role is a genuine development opportunity. For the right person, it's the foundation of a leadership career at Kong.

Interested? Reach out to Oscar Winberg to discuss.

jobs.title: Commerical Account Executive, Benelux
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About the Role:

We are looking for an experienced sales professional, ideally with open source experience who will be selling into mid market enterprise accounts. The ideal candidate has been a part of the sales efforts for other early-stage enterprise products in an entrepreneurial setting. The Account Executive will be integral to our growth plan and in acquiring new customers. Kong’s Account Executive will be the primary point of contact and the face of Kong for our prospects.

 

What You'll Do:

• Sell Kong Konnect Platform on Kong’s Commercial sales team.

• Meet and/or exceed individual quota, objectives and KPIs.

• Take ownership to build and manage your book of business, which includes understanding and documenting the buying criteria and process, determining the appropriate motion and patterns, ensuring pipeline accuracy based on evidence, and working the leads to closure.

• Collaborate and leverage an ecosystem of resources including pre sales, post sales, channel partners, customer success and leadership to promote Kong and drive new business.

 

What You'll Bring:

• A true desire to see customers benefit from the investment they make with Kong.

• 2+ years of experience in direct sales experience selling enterprise software to small to mid-size organisations ideally with open source, APIs, and/or infrastructure software.

• Effective communicator and strong interpersonal skills.

• Excellent negotiation, presentation and closing skills.

• Experience with fast growing startups is a plus.

• Strong background in territory planning and revenue generated from outbound pipeline.

• You have a measurable track record in new business development and over achieving sales targets.

• Knowledge of MEDDIC and Challenger methodologies is a plus.

 

Preferred:

• A top performer with experience hunting and closing net new logos.

• Experienced with creatively sourcing companies outside of your CRM.

• You have previously worked in an early-stage company and you know how to navigate and be successful in a fast-growing organization.

• Motivated, collaborative, driven and results oriented.

About the Role:

Kong is looking for an experienced Enterprise Account Executive to drive new business and expansion across large enterprise accounts. You’ll own the full sales cycle — from prospecting and pipeline generation through executive engagement, negotiation, and close.

This is an opportunity for a proven enterprise seller who thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and knows how to navigate complex SaaS, cloud, or infrastructure sales.

At Kong, we offer uncapped commissions with significant upside, competitive benefits, and equity in a company with strong growth potential.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the full enterprise sales cycle from prospecting through close and expansion.

  • Build and maintain a strong pipeline while consistently delivering against revenue targets.

  • Develop relationships with C-level executives and key decision-makers, becoming a trusted advisor.

  • Lead strategic account planning and identify new opportunities within enterprise accounts.

  • Partner across Product, Marketing, Customer Success, and technical teams to deliver the right solutions for customers.

  • Maintain accurate forecasting and pipeline management while staying ahead of market and competitive trends.

What You’ll Bring:

  • 7+ years of enterprise sales experience, ideally selling into organizations with 5,000+ employees.

  • Proven success closing complex, high-value deals within SaaS, cloud, infrastructure, or enterprise software.

  • Strong new-logo/hunter mentality with experience building pipeline and expanding strategic accounts.

  • Experience selling to C-level executives and navigating multiple stakeholders.

  • Strong consultative selling, negotiation, forecasting, and account-planning skills.

  • Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM platforms.

  • Knowledge of APIs, open source, cloud, or infrastructure technology is a plus.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment and take ownership of your territory.

Benefits & Growth at Kong

Strong Sales Momentum: Join a high-performing sales organization where 49% of reps are achieving 100%+ of quota and fully ramped reps are averaging 117% attainment.

Competitive Earning Potential: Competitive compensation with uncapped commissions designed to reward performance.

Equity Ownership: Eligible employees have the opportunity to share in Kong’s long-term growth through equity.

President’s Club: Exceptional performance is celebrated, with top sales performers having the opportunity to earn President’s Club.

Career Development: Structured onboarding, MEDDPICC training, ongoing sales enablement, coaching, and development designed to help you grow your career.

Global Opportunity: Work with enterprise customers and teams across the Americas, EMEA, and APJ while helping shape the future of API and AI connectivity.

Award-Winning Culture: Kong is Great Place To Work Certified™ in the U.S. for the fourth time, with 95% of surveyed employees saying Kong is a great place to work.

Wellbeing & Benefits: Health, wellness, retirement, parental, time-off, and other benefits are offered based on country and employment type.

Benefits, compensation, equity eligibility, incentive programs, and other offerings may vary based on location, role, and employment type.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About the Role:

We are seeking a committed Commercial Sales Executive with a successful background in sales and account management, ideally within open source or similar enterprise software environments. In this role, you will be a key driver of our growth strategy, directly impacting the stability and expansion of our recurring revenue. This position is ideal for a sales professional who has experience in landing new clients, retaining existing customers, and driving account expansion for early-stage enterprise products in a dynamic, entrepreneurial setting.

 

What You’ll Do:

  • Develop and execute sales strategies to target commercial customers, focusing on building and maintaining a robust pipeline that drives long-term growth.

  • Own the entire sales cycle, from prospecting and initial outreach to contract negotiations and closing deals, while consistently meeting or exceeding revenue targets.

  • Collaborate with internal teams, including product, marketing, and customer success, to ensure a seamless sales experience and alignment on customer needs.

  • Identify customer pain points and align our solutions to address these, delivering customized product demos and presentations tailored to their specific business needs.

  • Build and nurture relationships with C-level executives and key decision-makers within target accounts, establishing yourself as a trusted advisor and ensuring customer satisfaction and retention.

  • Lead account planning efforts by researching potential customers, understanding industry trends, and developing strategies to win new business and grow existing accounts.

  • Monitor and manage sales activities and results, accurately forecasting opportunities and keeping detailed records of interactions and progress in CRM systems.

  • Stay updated on industry trends, competitor offerings, and market changes to position our product effectively and maintain a competitive edge.

  • Contribute to business growth initiatives, providing feedback to product and marketing teams to influence product development and go-to-market strategies.

  • Represent Kong with professionalism, acting as a brand ambassador at industry events, conferences, and customer meetings.

 

What You’ll Bring:

  • 5+ years of experience in sales (<1k employees) a SaaS, cloud, or enterprise software environment.

  • 2+ years closing deals independently, preferably in Commercial & Mid-Market.

  • Demonstrated success in selling to small to medium enterprises, particularly to senior-level executives and across multiple departments.

  • Strong consultative selling skills, with the ability to understand customer needs and present compelling solutions that drive business outcomes.

  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills, capable of managing high-stakes conversations and building lasting relationships with stakeholders.

  • A results-driven mindset, with a passion for meeting and exceeding sales goals and revenue targets.

  • Experience working with CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce) and leveraging data to forecast accurately and track sales metrics.

  • Knowledge of open-source software, APIs, or infrastructure software is highly advantageous.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment, taking ownership of your sales territory and adapting to changing market dynamics.

  • Analytical and strategic thinking, with a knack for identifying business growth opportunities and devising plans to capitalize on them.

Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About the Role:

Kong is looking for an experienced Enterprise Account Executive to drive new business and expansion across large enterprise accounts. You’ll own the full sales cycle — from prospecting and pipeline generation through executive engagement, negotiation, and close.

This is an opportunity for a proven enterprise seller who thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and knows how to navigate complex SaaS, cloud, or infrastructure sales.

At Kong, we offer uncapped commissions with significant upside, competitive benefits, and equity in a company with strong growth potential.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the full enterprise sales cycle from prospecting through close and expansion.

  • Build and maintain a strong pipeline while consistently delivering against revenue targets.

  • Develop relationships with C-level executives and key decision-makers, becoming a trusted advisor.

  • Lead strategic account planning and identify new opportunities within enterprise accounts.

  • Partner across Product, Marketing, Customer Success, and technical teams to deliver the right solutions for customers.

  • Maintain accurate forecasting and pipeline management while staying ahead of market and competitive trends.

What You’ll Bring:

  • 7+ years of enterprise sales experience, ideally selling into organizations with 5,000+ employees.

  • Proven success closing complex, high-value deals within SaaS, cloud, infrastructure, or enterprise software.

  • Strong new-logo/hunter mentality with experience building pipeline and expanding strategic accounts.

  • Experience selling to C-level executives and navigating multiple stakeholders.

  • Strong consultative selling, negotiation, forecasting, and account-planning skills.

  • Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM platforms.

  • Knowledge of APIs, open source, cloud, or infrastructure technology is a plus.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment and take ownership of your territory.

Benefits & Growth at Kong

Strong Sales Momentum: Join a high-performing sales organization where 49% of reps are achieving 100%+ of quota and fully ramped reps are averaging 117% attainment.

Competitive Earning Potential: Competitive compensation with uncapped commissions designed to reward performance.

Equity Ownership: Eligible employees have the opportunity to share in Kong’s long-term growth through equity.

President’s Club: Exceptional performance is celebrated, with top sales performers having the opportunity to earn President’s Club.

Career Development: Structured onboarding, MEDDPICC training, ongoing sales enablement, coaching, and development designed to help you grow your career.

Global Opportunity: Work with enterprise customers and teams across the Americas, EMEA, and APJ while helping shape the future of API and AI connectivity.

Award-Winning Culture: Kong is Great Place To Work Certified™ in the U.S. for the fourth time, with 95% of surveyed employees saying Kong is a great place to work.

Wellbeing & Benefits: Health, wellness, retirement, parental, time-off, and other benefits are offered based on country and employment type.

Benefits, compensation, equity eligibility, incentive programs, and other offerings may vary based on location, role, and employment type.

For more information, visit www.konghq.com.

jobs.title: Commerical Account Executive
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About the Role:

We are looking for an experienced sales professional, ideally with open source experience who will be selling into mid market enterprise accounts. The ideal candidate has been a part of the sales efforts for other early-stage enterprise products in an entrepreneurial setting. The Account Executive will be integral to our growth plan and in acquiring new customers. Kong’s Account Executive will be the primary point of contact and the face of Kong for our prospects.

The role provides an opportunity to have real impact in a company scaling within a high-growth market plus uncapped commission and earnings potential.

Kong has the tech, the timing and the territory. Come and join our talented team!

 

What You'll Do:

• Sell Kong Konnect Platform as a member of Kong’s Commercial sales team.

• Meet and/or exceed individual quota, objectives and KPIs.

• Take ownership to build and manage your book of business, which includes understanding and documenting the buying criteria and process, determining the appropriate motion and patterns, ensuring pipeline accuracy based on evidence, and working the leads to closure.

• Collaborate and leverage an ecosystem of resources including pre sales, post sales, channel partners, customer success and leadership to promote Kong and drive new business.

 

What You'll ring:

• A true desire to see customers benefit from the investment they make with Kong.

• Direct sales experience selling enterprise software to small to mid-size organisations ideally with open source, APIs, and/or infrastructure software.

• Effective communicator and strong interpersonal skills.

• Excellent negotiation, presentation and closing skills.

• Experience with fast growing startups is a plus.

• Strong background in territory planning and revenue generated from outbound pipeline.

• You have a measurable track record in new business development and over achieving sales targets.

• Knowledge of MEDDIC and Challenger methodologies is a plus.

• Fluent English and Italian, Spanish and/or French is a big plus

 

Preferred:

• A top performer with experience hunting and closing net new logos.

• Experienced with creatively sourcing companies outside of your CRM.

• Structured approach to sales and pipeline generation

• You have previously worked in an early-stage company and you know how to navigate and be successful in a fast-growing organization.

• Motivated, collaborative, driven and results oriented.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About the Role:

You will be working at a dynamic and fast paced start-up as a member of the Customer Experience (CX) team. You will be enabling Customers to leverage APIs and microservices to drive their business initiatives in one of the most exciting and innovative technology domains in the industry. This team is responsible for interfacing with our customers throughout their lifecycle helping them realize the value of their Kong investment.

As a member of the CX team you will act as a champion for our most critical asset, our customers. You will be working with a portfolio of customers seeking to identify growth opportunities and ensuring they have what they need to be successful. In this role you will work alongside the Americas sales teams and will have the opportunity to build a large portfolio of Customers.

This is an incredibly exciting and challenging role at the forefront of technology, requiring someone with very strong organizational and communication skills. You will not only be building strong relationships with key customers, you will be pioneering the approach to managing customers by leveraging self service technology and re-usable assets to maximize the value Kong can provide.

Working at Kong presents a unique opportunity to help to modernize enterprise software and learn about how businesses run in the digital age.

Above all you’ll be acting as a stellar teammate for the rest of Kong.

 

What You'll Do:

  • Coaching our customers throughout their lifecycle while working collaboratively with the rest of the Customer Experience teams to ensure customer outcomes

  • Defining what ‘good’ looks like in terms of adoption plans, post-sales engagement, what is recommended and why

  • Working with Sales and Product teams to ensure our customers are getting the most out of the solution

  • Helping innovate our tooling and processes to make you and your team more efficient

  • Working on innovative and cutting edge customer projects

  • Learning our products and technologies, taking that knowledge and applying it to real world usage

  • Collaborating with other peers, business partners and groups. Representing not only yourself and the rest of your team but all of Kong and other exciting tasks you may identify to grow our company

What You'll Bring:

  • Have a builder’s mentality, seeking to find solutions to complex problems that will make life better for our customers and Kong

  • Manage a portfolio of commercial customers, looking for patterns that can be addressed through an automated approach using the latest customer engagement techniques

  • Have passion and determination about our technology and our customers

  • Be a self starter with strong organizational skills to drive effective customer outcomes

  • Have a good understanding of complex technology environments

  • Have great self awareness and strong communication skills

  • Ideally have prior experience of a similar role within SaaS, Open Source and/or Infrastructure software companies

  • Have a solid understanding of Cloud Native and the technologies that make it work (Containerization, Kubernetes, Microservices) as well as have a have a foundational understanding of APIM

  • Finally, understands the value of DevOps, CI/CD and Cloud Computing IaaS
